name: 명온공주 가례

src: 명온공주의 부마간택을 위해 12세에서 15세의 동자에게 금혼령을 내림.
name: 명온공주 부마 금혼령

src: 금위영(禁衛營)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
name: 금위영 주전 허가

src: 석호 유도성(石湖 柳道性) 출생
name: 유도성 출생

src: 을미의병 대장 척암 김도화(拓菴 金道和) 출생
name: 김도화 출생

src: 평안도 중화(中和)인 김치규(金致奎)가 청주 북문에 홍경래(洪景來)가 살아있다는 등의 내용으로 괘서하였다 처벌됨
name: 김치규 괘서 사건

src: 경주민들이 옥에서 자살한 사람의 시체 검시를 장기 현감에게 요구했다 거절당하자 칼과 몽둥이를 들고 관아에 들어가 수령을 위협함
name: 경주민 관아 습격

src: 청주에서 박형서(朴亨瑞)란 사람이 홍경래(洪景來)가 살아있다는 괘서를 한 김치규(金致奎)를 모방하여 진영(鎭營)에 괘서하였다가 처벌됨
name: 박형서 괘서 사건

src: 양종필(梁鍾佖)이라는 사람이 임금의 어가 행차 앞에서 격쟁(擊錚)함
name: 양종필 격쟁

src: 서산 김흥락(西山 金興洛) 출생
name: 김흥락 출생

src: 효현왕후 김씨(헌종비)가 안국방 외씨제에서 출생함.
name: 효현왕후 출생

src: 개성부(開城府)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
name: 개성부 주전 허가

src: 훈련도감(訓練都監)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
name: 훈련도감 주전 허가

src: 강화에서 수적(水賊) 김수온(金守溫)의 무리가 선원 14명을 바다에서 살해하고 재물을 탈취한 혐의로 체포됨
name: 김수온 해적 사건

src: 영의정 남공철(南公轍)이 은의 유출을 방지하고 은의 유입을 촉진하기 위해 은 가격을 인상할 것을 건의柳子厚,
name: 은 가격 인상 건의

src: 경기감영(京畿監營)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
name: 경기감영 주전 허가

src: 치암 이만현(恥岩 李晩鉉) 출생
name: 이만현 출생

src: 도성에서 시전(市廛)의 곡물 상인들과 경강(京江) 상인들의 농간으로 쌀값이 폭등하자 빈민들이 폭동을 일으켜 시전을 방화하고 파괴함
name: 도성 쌀값 폭동

src: 강시환이 수렴청정을 논하여 절도에 안치됨.
name: 강시환 유배

src: 을미의병장 담와 권세연(澹窩 權世淵) 출생
name: 권세연 출생

src: 충청도 대흥군(大興郡)에서 집권자들의 죄행을 폭로하여 괘서한 성국로(成國老), 이종려(李鍾呂)가 처벌됨
name: 대흥군 괘서 사건

src: 기해교화로 천주교도 130여 명이 처형되고 프랑스 신부 3명이 군문에 효수됨.
name: 기해박해

src: 대동미(大同米)를 동전으로 대납(代納)하게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
name: 대동미 동전 대납

src: 죽산 사람 안달원(安達源)이 관아에 불만을 품고 부사(府使) 행차시 가마를 부수고 하인을 구타함
name: 안달원 관아 난동

src: 탁지(度支)에 비축한 왜동(倭銅) 20만 근으로 동전을 주조하게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
name: 왜동 동전 주조

src: 항일자정순국 죽포 김순흠(竹圃 金舜欽) 출생
name: 김순흠 출생

src: 경주민 수백 명이 환곡의 폐단 시정을 요구하며 상경하여 연일 대궐문에서 상소함
name: 경주민 환곡 상소

src: 향산 이만도(響山 李晩燾) 출생
name: 이만도 출생

src: 경상도 산청에서 괘서한 김유선(金裕璿)을 효수하게 함
name: 김유선 괘서 사건

src: 독립운동가 백하 김대락(白下 金大洛) 출생
name: 김대락 출생

src: 총융청(摠戎廳)을 총위영(摠衛營)으로 고침
name: 총위영 개편

src: 왕비에게 후사가 없으므로 후궁을 둠.
name: 후궁 간택

src: 경외의 유생 8천명이 서류 허통을 청함.
name: 서류허통 청원

src: 은언군 인의 손 이원범(철종)을 왕사로 정함. 대왕대비가 수렴청정함.
name: 철종 즉위

src: 총위영(摠衛營)을 총융청(摠戎廳)으로 다시 개칭함.
name: 총융청 개칭

src: 의주(義州)백마산성(白馬山城)에 별장(別將)을 신설함.
name: 백마산성 별장 신설

src: 순흥부사 김숙연(金肅淵) 부임
name: 김숙연 순흥부사 부임

src: 서류를 허통시켜 모든 사환에 각별히 거두어 쓰라고 명함.
name: 서얼 허통령

src: 황해도 사람 채희재(蔡喜載)가 주동이 되어 난을 도모하다 처형됨
name: 채희재의 난

src: 명성왕후 민씨(고종비) 여주 근동면 섬낙리 사제에서 출생함.
name: 명성황후 출생

src: 봉화현감 임백능(任百能) 부임
name: 임백능 봉화현감 부임

src: 경상도 봉화에서 괘서한 사람들을 문초함
name: 봉화 괘서 사건

src: 영의정 김좌근(金左根)이 은화를 주조하여 동전과 함께 사용할 것을 건의韓國銀行,
name: 은화 주조 건의

src: 운강 이강년(雲崗 李康秊) 출생
name: 이강년 출생

src: 독립운동가 석주 이상룡(石州 李相龍) 출생
name: 이상룡 출생

src: 鳴條之戰，夏亡。
name: 명조 전투

src: 牧野之戰，商亡。
name: 목야 전투

src: 周成王元年，周公攝政，引發三監之亂。
name: 삼감의 난

src: 周懿王元年，鄭國的天亮了两次（天再旦，疑為日食）。
召穆公、周定公共同行政（一說由諸侯共伯和攝政），號稱共和。
name: 공화행정

src: 申侯聯合西方犬戎攻入西周都城鎬京，殺周幽王，周平王繼位。
name: 서주 멸망

src: 周平王向東遷都至洛邑。
name: 평왕 동천

src: 鄭莊公平定共叔段之亂。時為魯隱公元年，史書《春秋》編年始於此。
name: 공숙단의 난

src: 周平王、鄭莊公互派兒子為人質，周天子地位大為降低。
name: 주정 교질

src: 周桓王率諸侯軍隊伐鄭，被鄭莊公打敗且肩膀中箭，諸侯爭霸時代開始。
name: 수갈 전투

src: 楚武王熊通稱王，為諸侯稱王之始。
name: 초 무왕 칭왕

src: 齊桓公立，管仲相齊，實施變法。
name: 관중 변법

src: 齊桓公率諸侯聯軍迫楚國簽訂召陵之盟，成為春秋五霸之首。
name: 소릉의 맹약

src: 晉文公率兵救宋，在城濮之戰大敗楚軍，後會盟於踐土，成為中原霸主。
name: 성복 전투

src: 秦、晉會戰於殽，秦全軍覆沒。其後秦轉向西發展，稱霸西戎。
name: 효 전투

src: 楚、晉會戰於邲，楚大勝。
name: 필 전투

src: 宋大夫華元調和晉、楚，為第一次弭兵會盟。
name: 미병회맹

src: 宋大夫向戌邀晉楚和各諸侯國舉行第二次弭兵會盟，晉楚之間維持數十年和平。
name: 제2차 미병회맹

src: 吳王闔閭以伍子胥為將，統兵伐楚，攻進楚都郢。
name: 초 영도 함락

src: 孔子周遊列國始。
name: 공자 주유열국

src: 吳王夫差興兵敗越，越王勾踐求和。
name: 부초 전투

src: 越王勾踐消滅吳國，夫差自殺。勾踐與齊晉會盟於徐，為春秋最後一個霸主。
name: 오나라 멸망

src: 晉國氏族韓、趙、魏三家盡滅智氏，瓜分其地。
name: 삼가분지

src: 晉哀公死，晉幽公即位。韓、趙、魏瓜分晉國，只留絳與曲沃兩地。
name: 삼가분진

src: 魏伐秦，築臨晉、元裏。
name: 위나라 진 정벌

src: 魏伐中山。魏伐秦，至鄭而還，築雒陰、合陽。
name: 위나라 중산 정벌

src: 周威烈王承認韓、趙、魏為諸侯。司馬光《資治通鑒》所載始於此年。
name: 한조위 제후 책봉

src: 周安王正式冊命田和為齊侯，取代姜氏齊國。
name: 전씨대제

src: 齊康公死，姜太公香火斷絕，田氏併其食邑。
name: 강씨 제 멸망

src: 秦孝公任用商鞅，實施變法。
name: 상앙 변법

src: 魏軍圍攻趙都邯鄲，次年趙求救於齊，齊孫臏引兵圍攻魏都大梁，又在桂陵大敗魏軍。
name: 계릉 전투

src: 魏侯召集逢澤之會，率諸侯朝見周天子，為中原諸侯首先稱王者。
name: 봉택회맹

src: 魏發兵攻韓，韓求救於齊。
齊在馬陵之戰大敗魏軍，魏將龐涓兵敗自殺。
name: 마릉 전투

src: 秦拜卫鞅为商君。
name: 상앙 상군 책봉

src: 函谷關之戰，韓、趙、魏、楚、燕五國被秦軍擊退。
name: 함곡관 전투

src: 趙武靈王實行胡服騎射。
name: 호복기사

src: 齊、韓、魏、趙、宋、中山六國聯兵攻秦，秦割地予韓、魏以求和。
趙、魏、韓、燕、楚五國聯兵攻秦，秦被迫割地給趙、魏以求和。
齊國攻滅宋國。
name: 송 멸망

src: 燕、秦、韓、趙、魏五國聯兵攻齊，燕軍陷齊都臨淄。齊失七十餘城，只餘莒和即墨。
name: 오국연합 제 정벌

src: 秦將司馬錯攻陷楚國黔中，楚國割讓漢北及上庸予秦。
name: 검중 함락

src: 楚國於鄢之戰敗於秦軍。
name: 언 전투

src: 范雎向秦昭王獻「遠交近攻」之策。
name: 원교근공 책략

src: 秦伐韓，切斷上黨郡與韓都新鄭的聯繫。上黨求救於趙，趙派老將廉頗率軍聲援。
秦將白起在長平之戰大敗趙軍，坑殺40萬降卒。
name: 장평 전투

src: 魏信陵君、趙平原君、楚春申君於邯鄲城下大破秦軍；後信陵君率五國之兵於函谷關再勝秦軍。
name: 한단 전투

src: 周赧王號召天下諸侯攻秦，秦王怒而攻周，西周公投降。同年赧王卒，周民東亡，周朝滅亡。
name: 주나라 멸망

src: 秦相呂不韋帶兵滅位於鞏邑的東周公。
name: 동주 멸망

src: 韓、魏、趙、衛、楚五國聯兵擊秦，秦國反擊。楚再遷都至壽春以避秦軍。
秦滅趙。趙公子嘉自立為代王。
name: 조나라 멸망

src: 秦滅燕、越、代。
name: 연·대 멸망

src: 秦滅齊，統一中原。
name: 진의 중원 통일

src: 秦始皇分天下為三十六郡；統一度量衡，車同軌，書同文。
name: 군현제 시행

src: 秦始皇舉行封禪大典。
name: 봉선 대전

src: 秦始皇命蒙恬率三十萬大軍北伐匈奴，佔領河套地區。
name: 하투 점령

src: 秦始皇焚毀天下詩、書、百家語和非秦國史書。
name: 분서

src: 秦始皇在咸陽坑殺犯禁者四百六十餘人。
name: 갱유

src: 秦始皇亡於東巡。宦官趙高與丞相李斯擁立次子胡亥，假詔賜死長子扶蘇。
name: 사구정변

src: 陳勝、吳廣在大澤鄉「揭竿起義」，號為張楚，各地紛紛響應。
name: 진승·오광의 난

src: 趙高陷害李斯，腰斬於咸陽，夷三族。趙高為相。
name: 이사 처형

src: 項羽率楚軍於鉅鹿大破秦軍。同年劉邦入咸陽，秦王子嬰投降，秦亡。
name: 거록전투

src: 項羽尊楚懷王熊心為楚義帝。十二月，項羽自封為西楚霸王，分封十八路諸侯。劉邦被封為漢王。
name: 항우 서초패왕 즉위

src: 韓信領軍暗渡陳倉大敗章邯。
name: 암도진창

src: 項羽率西楚軍於彭城擊潰漢軍。
name: 팽성전투

src: 漢立韓信為齊王。
name: 한신 제왕 책봉

src: 漢軍包圍楚軍於垓下，項羽突圍後於烏江自刎而死。
name: 해하전투

src: 漢王劉邦即皇帝位，是爲漢高祖。韓信被改封為楚王。
name: 한고조 즉위

src: 漢高祖率漢軍北伐匈奴，被圍困於白登七天，賄賂匈奴閼氏才得以脫險。
name: 백등 포위

src: 陽夏侯陳豨及淮南王英布起兵反叛被平定。韓信及梁王彭越被殺，激起消滅異姓王。
name: 진희·영포의 난

src: 吳王劉濞等七個地方諸侯王聯合起兵叛變，史稱七國之亂，為太尉周亞夫率軍平定。
name: 칠국의 난

src: 是歲為漢武帝「建元」元年，是中國帝王使用年號之始。
name: 건원 연호 제정

src: 漢武帝採儒生董仲舒之議，罷黜百家，表章六經。
name: 독존유술

src: 張騫出使西域，十三年後返國。
name: 장건 서역 사행

src: 衛青北擊匈奴，攻取河南地、隴西、北地、上郡的北部，置朔方、五原二郡。
name: 위청의 흉노 정벌

src: 霍去病擊匈奴，征服河西走廊，設酒泉及武威二郡。後又分割為張掖、敦煌二郡。
name: 곽거병 하서주랑 정벌

src: 漢武帝頒布算緡令，後又頒布告緡令，徵收財產稅。
name: 산민령 시행

src: 漢武帝改革幣制，廢除半兩錢，改行五銖錢。
name: 오수전 도입

src: 漢平南越，西漢正式佔領嶺南。
name: 남월 평정

src: 《史記》成書。巫蠱之禍。
name: 사기 완성

src: 漢武帝下輪台罪己詔。
name: 윤대 죄기조

src: 漢宣帝正式設立西域都護府。
name: 서역도호부 설치

src: 王莽繼任大司馬大將軍。
name: 왕망 대사마 취임

src: 王莽立兩歲的孺子嬰為皇太子，自稱「攝皇帝」或「假皇帝」。
name: 왕망 섭정

src: 王莽篡漢，自立為帝，改國號為新。
name: 신 건국

src: 綠林軍興起於荊北。
name: 녹림군 봉기

src: 赤眉軍興起於青徐地區。
name: 적미군 봉기

src: 劉玄投降赤眉軍後被殺。劉秀為漢光武帝，國號仍為漢，史稱東漢或後漢。
name: 후한 건국

src: 馬援擊破先零羌於臨洮（今甘肅岷縣）。
name: 마원 강족 격파

src: 東漢統一戰爭結束。
name: 동한 통일 완성

src: 馬援平定交阯反叛（今越南中部）。
name: 마원 교지 평정

src: 班超出使疏勒。耿秉、竇固等出兵西域。
name: 반초 서역 파견

src: 南匈奴與漢朝聯軍大破北匈奴，迫使其西遷。
name: 북흉노 격파

src: 漢和帝與宦官鄭眾密謀鏟除外戚竇憲，宦官干政始。
name: 두헌 제거

src: 班超派甘英出使大秦，至安息西界而還。
name: 감영 대진 파견

src: 第一次黨錮之禍。
name: 제1차 당고의 화

src: 第二次黨錮之禍。
name: 제2차 당고의 화

src: 張角於鉅鹿、廣宗起兵反漢，黃巾之亂爆發。
name: 황건적의 난

src: 漢靈帝崩後，何進引董卓入京，董卓廢帝，各地軍閥舉兵反董卓。
name: 동탁의 집권

src: 董卓挾帝遷都長安，群雄割據的局面開始。
name: 동탁 장안 천도

src: 劉表擊敗孫堅。袁紹擊敗韓馥。
name: 유표, 손견 격파

src: 呂布殺董卓。董卓餘部李傕、郭汜等佔領長安。
name: 여포의 동탁 살해

src: 曹操挾漢獻帝到許昌。
name: 헌제 허창 이거

src: 袁術稱帝。張繡詐降擊敗曹操。
name: 원술 칭제

src: 曹操消滅了呂布的勢力。
name: 여포 세력 멸망

src: 袁紹消滅了公孫瓚的勢力。
name: 공손찬 세력 멸망

src: 曹操於官渡之戰擊敗袁紹軍。
name: 관도대전

src: 孫權、劉備聯軍於赤壁之戰大敗曹軍。
name: 적벽대전

src: 曹操討伐漢中張魯。韓遂，馬超反曹。
name: 조조 한중 정벌

src: 劉璋投降，劉備入主益州。
name: 유비 익주 입성

src: 漢獻帝被迫禪位，曹丕篡漢自立，改國號「魏」，史稱「曹魏」，東漢亡。
name: 조위 건국

src: 劉備於成都稱帝，國號仍為「漢」，史稱「蜀漢」。
name: 촉한 건국

src: 劉備戰敗於夷陵之戰，孫權取得大部分荊州。
name: 이릉대전

src: 劉備病歿，諸葛亮輔佐其子劉禪，並與孫權恢復同盟。
name: 유비 병사

src: 蜀漢諸葛亮平定南中叛軍，雍闓等被殺，孟獲投降。
name: 남중 평정

src: 孫權於建業稱帝，國號吳。
name: 오나라 건국

src: 諸葛亮最後一次北伐，同年病死於五丈原。
name: 제갈량 마지막 북벌

src: 蜀汉大將姜维第一次北伐。
name: 강유 첫 북벌

src: 曹魏大臣司馬懿發動政變，史稱高平陵之變，誅宗室曹爽。
name: 고평릉의 변

src: 滅蜀元勳鍾會及姜維叛變，被司馬昭平定，钟会及姜维被殺。
name: 종회의 난

src: 司馬炎篡魏自立，國號晉，曹魏滅亡。
name: 서진 건국

src: 晉滅吳，統一中國。三國時期結束。
name: 삼국 통일

src: 司馬炎下令六路晉軍攻吳。
name: 진의 오 정벌

src: 吳主孫皓出降，吳亡。
name: 손호 항복

src: 惠帝皇后賈南風唆使楚王司馬瑋殺汝南王司馬亮，開啟八王之乱。
name: 팔왕의 난

src: 氐族人楊茂搜率部落遷至仇池，稱王，史稱「前仇池」。
name: 전구지 건국

src: 凉州刺史张轨及其子张寔守土保境，中原百姓纷纷前来避乱。张氏虽然接受东晋封号，但与东晋相距万里，实际上也是一个割据政权。
name: 양주 할거

src: 匈奴貴族劉淵起兵，稱漢王。同年氐族李雄在益州稱成都王。
name: 유연 거병

src: 李雄稱帝，國號「成」。同年晉東海王司馬越消滅其他對手，控制朝政，毒死惠帝，立懷帝，八王之亂結束
name: 성한 건국

src: 慕容廆称前燕单于，开始割据，以龙城（今辽宁朝阳）为国都，招徕中原地区的汉族流民，组织屯田垦荒。
name: 모용외 할거

src: 劉淵稱帝，建都平陽，國號「漢」。
name: 유연 칭제

src: 刘渊死，刘聪即位。
name: 유총 즉위

src: 漢帝劉聰攻陷洛陽，擄晉懷帝司馬熾，放火焚宮，屠殺官民，史稱「永嘉之禍」。
name: 영가의 화

src: 祖逖受命為豫州刺史，率部屬北渡長江。
name: 조적의 북벌

src: 晉愍帝投降被殺，西晉滅亡。
name: 서진 멸망

src: 琅邪王司馬睿在建康稱晉王。
name: 사마예 진왕 칭호

src: 司馬睿即帝位，為晉元帝。
name: 동진 건국

src: 漢帝劉曜改國號為「趙」，史稱「前趙」。同年石勒稱趙王，史稱「後趙」。
name: 전조 건국

src: 涼州牧張茂建年號永元，已成為實質獨立政權。
name: 양주 독립

src: 晉元帝派戴淵為征西將軍，以監督祖逖。同年祖逖激憤患病而亡。
name: 조적 병사

src: 王敦起兵攻陷建康，史稱「王敦之亂」。同年石勒南進，再佔黃河以南之地。
name: 왕돈의 난

src: 慕容皝稱燕王，史稱「前燕」。
name: 전연 건국

src: 成帝李壽改國號為「漢」，史稱「成漢」。同年代王拓跋什翼犍自立，國號「代」。
name: 성한 개칭

src: 前燕擊敗了後趙的二十萬大軍，建都龍城。
name: 전연 후조 격파

src: 涼州張駿稱涼王，都姑臧，國號「涼」，史稱「前涼」。
name: 전량 건국

src: 東晉桓溫討伐成漢。
name: 환온 성한 토벌

src: 東晉桓溫滅成漢。
name: 성한 멸망

src: 氐族人苻洪佔據關中，稱三秦王，不久為後趙毒殺。同年冉閔奪後趙政權稱帝，國號「魏」，建都鄴，史稱「冉魏」。
name: 염위 건국

src: 苻健稱帝，定都長安，國號「大秦」，史稱「前秦」。
name: 전진 건국

src: 前燕殺冉閔，攻破鄴都，冉魏亡。
name: 염위 멸망

src: 東晉桓溫北伐前秦，苻健採用堅壁清野戰術，打敗晉軍，桓溫缺糧撤退。
name: 환온의 전진 북벌

src: 東晉桓溫擊潰河南姚襄，收復洛陽，修謁皇陵。
name: 환온 낙양 수복

src: 東晉桓溫討伐前燕，初勝，後為燕將慕容垂敗於枋頭。
name: 방두 전투

src: 前秦擒慕容暐，滅前燕。
name: 전연 멸망

src: 前秦滅前仇池。
name: 전구지 멸망

src: 前秦攻取東晉梁、益二州，西南夷邛、筰、夜郎皆歸附於秦。
name: 양익주 공취

src: 前秦滅前涼；同年，乘鮮卑拓跋氏衰亂之際，進兵滅代，統一北方。
name: 전진 북방통일

src: 前秦將領呂光討平西域。同年前秦出兵伐晉，大敗於淝水，史稱「淝水之戰」。
name: 비수대전

src: 前秦原前燕降將慕容垂自稱「燕王」，廢除前秦年號，建立後燕。北地長史慕容泓自稱濟北王，建立西燕；苻堅派子苻叡及羌人將領姚萇出兵討伐西燕，大敗。姚萇逃到渭北，建立後秦。
name: 후연 건국

src: 拓跋珪即代王位，重建代國；不久改國號為「魏」，史稱「北魏」。同年呂光稱大將軍、涼州牧。後燕、後秦、西燕皆先後稱帝。
name: 북위 건국

src: 呂光稱三河王，後改稱天王，史稱「後涼」。
name: 후량 건국

src: 後燕伐北魏，大敗於參合陂。
name: 참합피 전투

src: 拓跋珪稱帝，為魏道武帝。同年後秦乘東晉內亂，陷洛陽，淮漢以北諸城多請降。
name: 북위 도무제 즉위

src: 東晉桓玄篡位稱帝，建國桓楚。
name: 환초 건국

src: 劉裕舉兵討伐桓玄，桓玄敗走蜀地，途中被殺。
name: 환현 토벌

src: 劉裕肅清桓氏勢力，迎晉安帝復位，掌控朝廷。
name: 진안제 복위

src: 漢人馮跋滅後燕，擁立高雲為天王，建都龍城，國號仍用「燕」，史稱「北燕」。同年匈奴人赫連勃勃自稱大夏天王、大單于，建立大夏政權。
name: 북연 건국

src: 高雲被部下所殺，馮跋平定政變後即天王位於昌黎。
name: 풍발 즉위

src: 東晉破長安，姚泓降，後秦亡。
name: 후진 멸망

src: 大夏取長安，稱帝。
name: 대하 칭제

src: 夏主赫連定滅西秦；欲渡黃河擊北涼遭吐谷渾襲擊，兵敗被俘，夏亡。
name: 서진 멸망

src: 北魏滅北涼，統一北方。
name: 북위 북방통일

src: 宋將軍蕭道成弒帝劉昱，擁立宋順帝，獨攬朝政。
name: 소도성 정변

src: 蕭道成篡位，建國號「齊」，史稱齊高帝，劉宋亡。
name: 남제 건국

src: 齊宗室蕭衍篡位，建國號「梁」，史稱梁武帝，南齊亡。
name: 양 건국

src: 原平代县地震，5310人死亡， 2722人受伤。
name: 원평·대현 지진

src: 北魏孝武帝元修與權臣高歡關係決裂，逃到關中投奔宇文泰。高歡在鄴城擁元善見為帝，是為東魏。其後宇文泰殺元修，在長安立元寶炬為帝，是為西魏。
name: 동위·서위 분열

src: 東魏降將侯景勾結梁京城守將蕭正德，舉兵謀反，史稱「侯景之亂」。
name: 후경의 난

src: 高歡的兒子高洋建立北齊，東魏亡。
name: 북제 건국

src: 侯景自立為漢帝。
name: 후경 칭제

src: 陳霸先、王僧辯先後擊敗侯景，侯景為部下所殺。
name: 후경 토벌

src: 梁湘東王蕭繹繼位於江陵，為梁元帝。
name: 양 원제 즉위

src: 蕭詧引西魏軍攻陷江陵，殺害梁元帝。
name: 강릉 함락

src: 蕭詧稱帝，並對西魏稱臣，史稱「後梁」。
name: 후량 건국

src: 梁權臣陳霸先篡位，建國「陳」，史稱•陳武帝，南梁亡。同年宇文泰的兒子宇文覺建立北周，西魏亡。
name: 진 건국

src: 北周軍攻佔鄴城，高緯逃亡被擒，北齊亡。
name: 북제 멸망

src: 北周外戚楊堅自稱大丞相。
name: 양견 대승상 취임

src: 隋文帝命宇文愷興建廣通渠。
name: 광통거 건설

src: 隋軍攻入建康，陳叔寶被俘，南陳亡。
name: 남진 멸망

src: 突厥汗国沙缽略可汗舉兵入侵隋朝。
name: 돌궐의 수 침공

src: 隋軍分八路北伐突厥。
name: 수의 돌궐 정벌

src: 高句麗襲擊遼西，隋文帝派漢王楊諒迎戰，敗於高句麗。
name: 고구려의 요서 습격

src: 東突厥突利可汗戰敗降隋。
name: 돌리가한 항복

src: 隋征服越南前李朝，北越南地區納入版圖。
name: 전리조 정복

src: 隋煬帝派楊素、宇文愷於洛陽興建東都。
name: 동도 건설

src: 遷都洛陽。同年隋煬帝開鑿通濟渠。同年隋將韋雲起率突厥兵大敗契丹。
name: 낙양 천도

src: 西突厥處羅可汗降隋。
name: 처라가한 항복

src: 隋煬帝發兵討伐高句麗，大敗。
name: 살수대첩

src: 隋煬帝再次發兵征討高句麗，因楊素子楊玄感謀反，退兵回國鎮壓。
name: 고구려 2차 원정 철군

src: 隋煬帝三度發兵征討高句麗，嬰陽王遣返楊玄感同黨斛斯政，隋因而撤軍。
name: 고구려 3차 원정 철군

src: 宇文化及等人發動兵變，弒煬帝。同年李淵受隋恭帝楊侑禪讓，建立唐朝。
name: 당 건국

src: 王世充廢他所擁立的另一位隋恭帝楊侗，隋亡。同年王世充自立為帝，建國號「鄭」。
name: 수 멸망

src: 李世民擊敗入侵河東的劉武周、宋金剛。同年洛陽鄭帝王世充與河北夏帝竇建德結盟抗唐。
name: 유무주 격파

src: 李世民擊潰鄭、夏聯軍，俘竇建德，王世充投降。
name: 정·하 연합군 격파

src: 李世民發動玄武門之變。李淵讓位，成為太上皇。李世民繼位，即唐太宗。
name: 현무문의 변

src: 唐將李靖率騎兵攻滅東突厥。
name: 동돌궐 멸망

src: 唐將李靖攻佔吐谷渾。
name: 토욕혼 정복

src: 唐派文成公主與吐蕃贊普松贊干布通婚。
name: 문성공주 토번 혼인

src: 武昭儀被立為皇后。
name: 무소의 황후 책립

src: 唐將蘇定方西征攻下西突厥汗國。
name: 서돌궐 멸망

src: 武后殺宰相上官儀，權力日盛，與高宗並稱“二圣”。
name: 이성 칭호

src: 唐與新羅之間的戰爭爆發。
name: 나당전쟁 발발

src: 吐谷渾故地為吐蕃所佔。
name: 토욕혼 고지 병합

src: 高句麗舊地為新羅所佔。
name: 고구려 고지 신라 병합

src: 武則天廢睿宗，即帝位，改國號「周」，定都洛陽，史稱「武周」。同年，武則天創殿試。
name: 무주 건국

src: 金城公主嫁入吐蕃。同年，韋后與安樂公主謀殺中宗，立李重茂為帝，韋后攝政。同年，李隆基率禁軍殺韋后等，擁其父睿宗為帝。
name: 금성공주 토번 혼인

src: 唐睿宗傳位於李隆基，是為唐玄宗。
name: 당 현종 즉위

src: 玄宗改元開元。
name: 개원 연호 제정

src: 安祿山為平盧節度使。同年，李白入長安。
name: 안록산 평로절도사 임명

src: 唐將高仙芝於怛羅斯戰役敗於阿拔斯王朝與石國聯軍。
name: 탈라스 전투

src: 安史叛軍入長安，唐玄宗出奔蜀地。至馬嵬驛，軍士嘩變，楊國忠、楊貴妃被殺。
name: 마외역 병변

src: 史朝義自縊，安史之亂平定。
name: 안사의 난 평정

src: 涇原兵變，唐德宗出奔。
name: 경원병변

src: 吐蕃陷安西都護府，西域自此斷絕。
name: 안서도호부 함락

src: 唐憲宗即位，是為元和中興。
name: 원화중흥

src: 全國節度使服從。藩鎮割據局面暫告結束。
name: 번진할거 종결

src: 唐武宗即位，是為會昌中興。
name: 회창중흥

src: 唐武宗大規模取締佛教。
name: 회창폐불

src: 唐宣宗即位，是為大中之治。同年李德裕被貶，自此黨爭漸平。
name: 대중지치

src: 張議潮起義反吐蕃，復十一州歸唐。被任命為歸義軍節度使。
name: 장의조 봉기

src: 王仙芝在長垣起兵。
name: 왕선지의 난

src: 黃巢連敗於李克用、朱溫，後為部下所殺。
name: 황소의 난 진압

src: 錢鏐任鎮海節度使。
name: 전류 진해절도사 임명

src: 大迭烈府夷离堇（军事首领）领兵40万伐河东代北，下九郡。
name: 하동대북 정벌

src: 朱全忠殺宰相崔胤，逼迫唐昭宗遷都洛陽。
name: 낙양 천도

src: 十二月，遥辇氏部落联盟首领痕德堇可汗去世，遗命推选阿保机为汗。
name: 아보기 가한 추대

src: 朱温逼迫唐哀宗禅让，建國號「梁」，史稱「後梁」。唐亡，進入五代十國時期。高季興任荊南節度使。後梁封錢鏐為吳越王。
name: 후량 건국

src: 耶律阿保機登基稱「大聖大明天皇帝」，定國號為「契丹」。
name: 거란 건국

src: 南海王劉龑在番禺稱帝，國號「大越」。
name: 대월 건국

src: 大越改國號為「漢」，史稱「南漢」。契丹定都臨潢府（巴林左旗）。
name: 남한 건국

src: 李存勗在太原稱帝，建國號「唐」，史稱「後唐」莊宗。同年唐軍攻入汴州，後梁亡。
name: 후당 건국

src: 高季興受封為南平王，成立割據政權，以荊州為首府，史稱「南平」或「荊南」。
name: 형남 성립

src: 後唐莊宗派郭崇韜、李繼岌率軍攻入成都，王衍投降，前蜀亡。
name: 전촉 멸망

src: 耶律阿保機東征渤海國。
name: 발해 정벌

src: 东丹王耶律倍南逃后唐。
name: 야율배 망명

src: 西川節度使孟知祥殺東川節度使董璋，取得東川，被後唐明宗封為蜀王。
name: 맹지상 촉왕 책봉

src: 孟知祥在成都稱帝，國號「蜀」，史稱「後蜀」。
name: 후촉 건국

src: 契丹與石敬瑭聯軍攻入洛陽，後唐滅亡。石敬瑭稱帝，國號「晉」，史稱「後晉」，移都開封。
name: 후진 건국

src: 石敬瑭割讓燕雲十六州予契丹。
name: 연운십육주 할양

src: 契丹派張彥澤率兵入開封，石重貴投降，後晉亡。契丹改國號為「大遼」。
name: 후진 멸망

src: 河東節度使劉知遠於太原稱帝，國號「漢」，史稱「後漢」。
name: 후한 건국

src: 郭威誅隱帝，建都汴，改國號「周」，史稱「後周」。後漢亡。
name: 후주 건국

src: 南唐將領邊鎬率軍攻楚，佔領長沙，楚滅亡。馬殷舊將劉言起兵擊敗南唐軍，繼續據有楚地。
name: 초 멸망

src: 王進逵殺劉言，控制楚地。
name: 왕진규 초 장악

src: 部將潘叔嗣殺王進逵。潭州軍府事周行逢進軍朗州殺潘叔嗣，被後周任命為武平節度使，控制楚地。後周攻佔後蜀之秦、階、成、鳳四州。
name: 주행봉 초 장악

src: 殿前都點檢趙匡胤謊報兵情，借口領兵到陳橋驛發動兵變，奪取後周帝位，建國號「宋」。
name: 진교의 변

src: 周行逢死，子周保權繼位，部將張文表起兵反叛，兵敗被殺。宋發兵攻佔潭州。
name: 송의 담주 점령

src: 宋軍攻佔江陵，高繼沖投降，荊南亡。宋軍平定武平。
name: 형남 멸망

src: 宋太祖發兵攻後蜀。
name: 후촉 정벌

src: 孟昶投降，後蜀亡。
name: 후촉 멸망

src: 宋發兵討伐南漢。
name: 남한 정벌

src: 劉鋹投降，南漢亡。
name: 남한 멸망

src: 宋發兵討伐南唐。
name: 남당 정벌

src: 宋軍攻陷金陵，李煜奉表投降，南唐亡。
name: 남당 멸망

src: 遼景宗耶律賢發兵伐宋，遼軍攻佔瓦橋關後退去。
name: 요의 송 침공

src: 大遼改國號回「契丹」。
name: 거란 국호 환원

src: 宋發兵伐遼，敗於岐溝關。
name: 기구관 전투

src: 宋、遼訂立澶淵之盟。
name: 전연의 맹약

src: 李元昊稱帝，即夏景宗，定都興州並改稱為興慶府，國號「大夏」，史稱「西夏」。山西定襄—忻州一帶發生7.25級地震，造成32308人死亡，5600人受傷。
name: 서하 건국

src: 遼興宗以國內西南部的党項叛附西夏為由，於隔年冬率大軍伐夏。西夏求和不成，採取堅壁清野方式擊潰遼軍。
name: 요의 서하 정벌

src: 宋夏戰爭平息，雙方簽訂慶曆和議，宋朝承認西夏的割據地位。
name: 경력화의

src: 夏毅宗參與政事，沒藏訛龐密謀刺殺夏毅宗，後被夏帝誅殺全家。
name: 몰장눌방의 모반

src: 契丹再改國號回「大遼」。
name: 대요 국호 복원

src: 宋神宗任王安石為參知政事，推動變法。
name: 왕안석 변법

src: 西夏內亂之際，宋以李憲為總指揮發動五路伐夏，奪下蘭州。
name: 오로벌하

src: 宋軍採取碉堡戰術，派徐禧興建永樂城，梁太后趁永樂城新建之初，率30萬大軍包圍攻陷，宋軍慘敗，史稱永樂城之戰。
name: 영락성 전투

src: 夏崇宗親政後採取依附遼朝，與北宋修和的策略，逐年減少戰爭。
name: 서하 숭종의 화친 정책

src: 女真族完顏阿骨打起兵反遼。
name: 완안아골타의 거병

src: 完顏阿骨打於會寧府建都立國，國號「大金」。
name: 금 건국

src: 宋江聚眾在梁山泊起事。前郭卡拉木地震，数千人死亡。
name: 송강의 난

src: 方臘率眾在歙縣七賢村起事。
name: 방랍의 난

src: 宋軍生擒方臘，送往汴京誅殺。宋江戰敗被俘。
name: 방랍 생포

src: 宋軍平定方臘餘黨。
name: 방랍 잔당 평정

src: 遼天祚帝被俘，遼國亡。耶律大石率軍西行，於西域建立西遼。金朝西夏夾攻北宋，西夏佔領天德軍、雲內等地。
name: 요 멸망

src: 宋地被金朝強佔，並且被強索河東八館之地。金朝為了補償西夏，同意佔領陝西後將橫山地區歸還，但又違約。
name: 하동팔관 강탈

src: 金兵攻陷宋都汴京，擄走宋帝徽、欽二宗，史稱「靖康之變」。金國立張邦昌為帝，國號「大楚」，32天後張邦昌自行退位。宋康王趙構在南京（今河南商丘）登基為帝，史稱「南宋」
name: 정강의 변

src: 完顏宗弼揮軍南下，高宗南逃至杭州。完顏宗弼繼續揮軍南下，高宗乘船出海避難。宋將韓世忠率八千精兵，堵塞五萬金軍在黃天盪四十八天。史稱黃天盪之戰。
name: 황천탕 전투

src: 劉豫在金授意下即帝位，國號「大齊」，定都大名府，統治金所佔黃河以南地區。
name: 대제 건국

src: 金廢劉豫為蜀王，齊亡。
name: 제 멸망

src: 宋金初次協議，南宋取回包含開封的河南、陝西之地。
name: 송금 하남·섬서 반환

src: 金朝撕毀協議，金兵分三路南侵，重佔開封與陝西等地，岳飛在郾城與金兵將領完顏宗弼會戰，力挫金兵，進兵朱仙鎮，收復了黃河以南一帶。
name: 언성 전투

src: 宋、金簽訂「紹興和議」，宋朝稱臣，並與金以淮河為界。
name: 소흥화의

src: 金主完顏亮起兵伐宋，被虞允文在采石矶击退，史称釆石磯之役。
name: 채석기 전투

src: 鐵木真獲得尊號「成吉思汗」，建國於漠北，國號「大蒙古國」。
name: 몽골 제국 건국

src: 韓侂冑被殺，雙方議和，史稱嘉定和議。
name: 가정화의

src: 南宋與蒙古協議聯手擊退金軍，南宋可獲河南作回報。
name: 몽송 연합 협정

src: 蒙古攻取金朝首都中都。
name: 중도 함락

src: 蒙古將中都改名為燕京。
name: 연경 개칭

src: 孛魯率軍從東面攻入西夏，攻陷銀州，夏將塔海被俘。
name: 은주 함락

src: 蒙古與宋聯軍攻陷蔡州，金哀宗自殺，金末帝死於亂軍中，金亡。
name: 금 멸망

src: 宋軍收復被蒙古軍佔領的襄陽和其他地區。
name: 양양 수복

src: 蒙古軍越過淮河以南入侵宋。
name: 몽골의 남송 침공

src: 蒙古凉州会盟，吐蕃归附。
name: 양주회맹

src: 蒙古灭大理国。
name: 대리국 멸망

src: 蒙哥大汗蒙哥親征釣魚城，被火炮擊傷，後逝於溫泉寺，蒙古軍撤退。
name: 조어성 전투

src: 忽必烈即帝位。阿里不哥起兵，和忽必烈争位。蒙古发行纸币中统元宝交钞。
name: 쿠빌라이 칸 즉위

src: 蒙古迁都开平。
name: 개평 천도

src: 蒙古將开平改名為上都 。
name: 상도 개칭

src: 阿里不哥兵败投降。蒙古將燕京改名中都。
name: 아리크부카 항복

src: 蒙古迁都中都，修建皇城和宫城。
name: 중도 천도

src: 蒙古改國號為「大元」，蒙古文稱為「大元大蒙古國」，史稱「元朝」。
name: 대원 국호 선포

src: 元中都改名大都。
name: 대도 개명

src: 元颁布官修农书《农桑辑要》。
name: 농상집요 반포

src: 元第一次征日。
name: 제1차 일본 정벌

src: 马可波罗到达中国。
name: 마르코 폴로 중국 도착

src: 元軍入临安，俘5歲宋帝恭宗。
name: 임안 함락

src: 宋軍於厓山海域敗於元軍，丞相陸秀夫負幼主趙昺跳海殉國，宋流亡政府亡。
name: 애산 전투

src: 直隶地震，约10万人死亡。
name: 직예 지진

src: 马可波罗离开中国。
name: 마르코 폴로 중국 출국

src: 元朝和窝阔台汗国、察合台汗国约和，四大汗国一致承认元朝皇帝的宗主地位；洪洞趙城地震，造成200,000到475,800人死亡。
name: 4대 칸국 종주권 승인

src: 四大汗国彼此之间约和，蒙古帝国内战彻底结束。
name: 몽골제국 내전 종식

src: 下诏恢复科举。
name: 과거 부활

src: 《大元圣政国朝典章》（《元典章》）修成。
name: 원전장 완성

src: 颁布法律《大元通制》，《至元新格》停止使用。
name: 대원통제 반포

src: 《辽史》、《金史》修成。
name: 요사·금사 편찬

src: 颁布法律《至正条格》，《大元通制》停止使用。
name: 지정조격 반포

src: 韩山童、刘福通發動紅巾之亂。
name: 홍건적의 난

src: 红巾军攻陷上都，焚毁宫殿后离去。
name: 상도 함락

src: 朱元璋於南京稱帝，國號「大明」。明军攻陷元大都，元順帝率宗室、臣僚逃回蒙古草原，國號仍為「大元」，迁都上都，不再統治汉地，史稱「北元」。
name: 명나라 건국

src: 定科举法。北元迁都和林。
name: 과거법 제정

src: 丞相胡惟庸被處死，宰相制度自此廢止。
name: 호유용의 옥

src: 明军攻取云南，元朝梁王把匝剌瓦尔密自杀。
name: 운남 정복

src: 再定科举取士制。
name: 과거 취사제 재정

src: 《鱼鳞图册》问世。明军攻取东北，元军统帅纳哈出降明。
name: 어린도책 반포

src: 天元帝内乱中被杀，此后北元去国号灭亡（清修《明史》说法为1402年），为鞑靼所取代。
name: 북원 멸망

src: 明太祖死，建文帝即位。
name: 건문제 즉위

src: 燕軍攻克南京，建文帝失蹤，方孝孺被杀；燕王即位，是為明成祖。
name: 정난의 변

src: 郑和第一次下西洋。
name: 정화의 첫 항해

src: 《永乐大典》问世。
name: 영락대전 편찬

src: 明成祖駕崩，明仁宗、明宣宗父子相繼即位，開啟「仁宣之治」。
name: 인선지치

src: 宣宗崩，九歲的朱祁鎮即位，是為明英宗，改元正統。
name: 명영종 즉위

src: 土木堡之变，宦官王振慫恿英宗親征瓦剌，明軍大敗，明英宗也被瓦剌军也先俘虜。同年，英宗弟朱祁鈺被立為帝，改元景泰，即景帝，命于謙與北京抵禦瓦剌入侵，瓦剌大敗，史稱「北京保衛戰」。
name: 토목의 변

src: 奪門之變，在景泰帝病重時，宦官曹吉祥、大臣石亨等人發動政變，迫景帝讓位，英宗再次稱帝，改元天顺。
name: 탈문의 변

src: 庆阳流星雨事件，砸死1万人。
name: 경양 유성우 사건

src: 《大明会典》问世。
name: 대명회전 편찬

src: 王阳明平定宁王宸濠之乱。
name: 신호의 난 평정

src: 葡萄牙获澳门居住权。
name: 마카오 거주권 획득

src: 俞大猷、戚继光于福建破倭寇。
name: 왜구 격파

src: 海瑞因非难嘉靖帝入狱。同年嘉靖帝驾崩，隆庆帝奉遗诏命海瑞出狱。
name: 해서 하옥

src: 高拱遭罢免，张居正为首辅，推行改革。
name: 장거정 개혁

src: 李时珍《本草纲目》问世。
name: 본초강목 완성

src: 日本丰臣秀吉出兵朝鲜，朝鮮向明朝求援，萬曆朝鮮之役始。
name: 임진왜란

src: 日本第二次出兵朝鲜。
name: 정유재란

src: 意大利耶稣教会传教士利玛窦抵達北京。
name: 마테오 리치 베이징 도착

src: 努尔哈赤即帝位，国号大金（后金），定都兴京。
name: 후금 건국

src: 魏忠賢升任秉筆太監，官宦之争起。
name: 위충현 병필태감 임명

src: 宁夏固原北部发生7级地震。
name: 닝샤 구위안 지진

src: 魏忠贤为东厂长官。
name: 위충현 동창 수장 취임

src: 北京西南隅的工部王恭厂火药库发生王恭厰大爆炸，造成2万多人死伤。
name: 왕공창 대폭발

src: 陕西大饥荒，李自成乱起。
name: 이자성의 난

src: 山西爆发“明末大鼠疫”，后传入北京城，导致20余万人死亡。
name: 명말 대서역병

src: 大金改国号「大清」，皇太极称帝，清朝建立。
name: 청나라 건국

src: 宋应星著《天工开物》。
name: 천공개물 저술

src: 洪承疇降清。
name: 홍승주 청나라 항복

src: 李自成建國號「大順」，攻陷北京，明亡。山海關總兵吳三桂引清兵入關，擊敗大順軍。清攝政王多爾袞與順治帝入關，遷都北京，入主中原。明鳳陽總督馬士英等擁立福王朱由崧於南京即帝位，為弘光帝。
name: 명나라 멸망

src: 隆武绍宗（朱聿鍵）唐王即位福州。
name: 융무제 즉위

src: 紹武唐王（朱聿𨮁）即位于广州。永历桂王（朱由榔）即位肇庆。
name: 소무제 즉위

src: 郑成功以金门、厦门为据点抗清。
name: 정성공 항청 거점

src: 郑成功封延平郡王。
name: 연평군왕 책봉

src: 桂王逃缅甸。朱舜水归化日本，和水户学派往来。
name: 계왕 미얀마 망명

src: 郑成功攻台湾，驱荷兰人。
name: 정성공 타이완 수복

src: 吴三桂杀永历桂王。
name: 영력제 피살

src: 德国耶稣教会传教士汤若望去世。
name: 아담 샬 사망

src: 山东郯城发生规模8.5级大地震，压毙5万余人。
name: 산둥 탄청 대지진

src: 河北省大厂回族自治县夏垫镇发生8级大地震，是北京附近历史上发生的最大地震，死亡总数未知，但据估计约有超过45,500人死亡。
name: 허베이 다창 대지진

src: 施琅攻台湾，郑克塽投降。
name: 정극상 항복

src: 山西临汾发生8级大地震，死亡5万2600人。
name: 산시 임분 대지진

src: 宁夏中卫发生7级地震，死亡2千多人。
name: 닝샤 중위 지진

src: 甘肃通渭发生7.5级地震，死亡4万余人，伤3万余人。
name: 간쑤 통위 지진

src: 台湾朱一贵举兵反清失败。
name: 주일귀의 난

src: 驱逐各地基督教传教士。
name: 기독교 선교사 추방

src: 《古今图书集成》问世。
name: 고금도서집성 완성

src: 宁夏平罗，银川一带发生该区有史以来最大的8级地震，压死5万多人。
name: 닝샤 핑뤄 대지진

src: 《四库全书薈要》问世。
name: 사고전서회요 완성

src: 康定-泸定地震，据当时记载，地震死亡仅430余人，但因地震堰塞湖所淹没及坝倒大水冲刷使沿河两岸村镇因水灾死亡近10万人。
name: 캉딩-루딩 지진

src: 台湾天地会林爽文反清。
name: 임상문의 난

src: 印尼坦博拉火山的爆发造成全球性气温下降，云南全省出现严重饥荒。（无夏之年）
name: 탐보라 화산 폭발

src: 中英簽署《南京條約》，第一次鴉片戰爭結束。
name: 남경조약 체결

src: 咸丰黄河大改道。
name: 황허 유로 변경

src: 清廷簽署中俄、中美、中英、中法的《天津條約》。
name: 톈진 조약 체결

src: 英法聯軍攻入北京，火烧圆明园。清廷簽署中英、中法、中俄的《北京條約》，英法联军之役結束。
name: 원명원 방화

src: 洋務運動開始。恭親王奕訢設立首個外交機構總理各國事務衙門（總理衙門）。慈禧垂廉聽政開始。
name: 양무운동

src: 甘陕同治回乱起。
name: 동치 회란

src: 洪秀全病逝。天京被湘軍攻破，湘军进行屠城。
name: 천경 함락

src: 李鸿章立江南制造局。
name: 강남제조국 설립

src: 左宗棠设福州船政局。
name: 푸저우 선정국 설립

src: 太平天國最後一支軍隊覆滅。
name: 태평천국 멸망

src: 甲戌风灾横过珠江口，先后吹袭香港及澳门，远至广州亦受灾害，香山县的死亡人数超过20,000人。
name: 갑술 태풍

src: 丁戊奇荒，一场罕见的特大旱灾饥荒，造成900万至1,300万人饿死。
name: 정무기황

src: 沈葆禎聘法国工程師于台南建成億载金城。左宗棠讨伐阿古柏，李鸿章反对无效。
name: 억재금성 축조

src: 中俄伊犁交涉。
name: 이리 교섭

src: 春左宗棠在新疆部署兵事。日本正式吞并琉球，废除其国王，将琉球改为冲绳县。甘肃省武都区发生8级地震，导致大约22000人死亡。
name: 류큐 병합

src: 中俄《伊犁条约》签定。
name: 이리 조약 체결

src: 刘铭传任台湾省巡抚。台湾建立行省。
name: 대만 건성

src: 河南郑州下汛十堡（今惠济区花园口镇石桥村）发生黄河决口，致使200多万（一说93万；一说最保守估计150万；一说700万）人罹难。
name: 정저우 황하 범람

src: 光绪亲政开始。张之洞任湖广总督，推动洋务运动。
name: 광서제 친정

src: 中日甲午战争始。日军在旅顺进行大屠杀，超过两万人遇害。唐景崧任台湾省巡抚。興中會（中國國民黨前身）成立。
name: 청일전쟁

src: 與日本簽訂《馬關條約》，甲午戰爭結束。洋務運動失敗收場。
name: 시모노세키 조약

src: 谭嗣同、康有为戊戌变法。
name: 무술변법

src: 道士王圓籙于敦煌石窟第17窟发现大量书画经卷。
name: 둔황 문서 발견

src: 義和團事變。八國聯軍攻入北京，庚子戰爭。庚子俄难，俄军在海兰泡和江东六十四屯进行屠杀，超过七千人遇害。
name: 의화단 운동

src: 废八股，用策论。清廷簽署《辛丑條約》。
name: 신축조약 체결

src: 废科举。丙午风灾侵袭广东珠江口一带，肇庆高要的新江云松岭文阁上三层完全倒塌，下二层石额破裂，墙壁崩颓。东莞万顷沙围堤崩溃。
name: 과거제 폐지

src: 徐錫麟、馬宗漢、秋瑾被捕处死。
name: 추근 등 처형

src: 西江水灾，伤亡千余人。
name: 서강 수재

src: 东北鼠疫，波及69个县，共死亡6万余人。
name: 동북 페스트

src: 黃兴广州起义，黄花岗事件。辛亥革命爆发，南方各省独立，清朝开始瓦解。
name: 신해혁명 발발

src: 在袁世凯软硬兼施的逼迫下，清帝宣布退位，清朝正式灭亡。
name: 청 황제 퇴위

src: 4月27日黄花岗起义。保路运动。10月10日湖北发生武昌起義，引发辛亥革命。
name: 우창 봉기

src: 中華民國南京臨時政府成立，孫文任臨時大總統。2月12日溥仪頒布《宣統帝退位詔書》，清朝亡。袁世凱於北京就任第二屆臨時大總統。
name: 중화민국 임시정부 수립

src: 候任国务总理宋教仁被殺，革命党人发动二次革命，遂被北洋军大败，袁世凱就任第一屆大總統
name: 쑹자오런 피살

src: 袁世凱稱帝，改國號為中華帝國，云南将领蔡鍔等南部革命家组成护国军發動護國戰爭。5月25日中日民四条约签订。中共创始人之一的陳獨秀創立《青年雜誌》
name: 위안스카이 칭제

src: 6月6日袁世凱病逝。黎元洪就任總統，段祺瑞任國務總理。10月31日黄兴病逝。
name: 위안스카이 병사

src: 府院之爭，張勛拥护溥儀復辟失敗，孫中山廣州建大元帥府发动護法運動。吳稚暉編《國音字典》。毛澤東于長沙設新民學會。8月14日段祺瑞領導的北洋政府和中華民國第一屆國會通過了《對德宣戰案》，中華民國宣布对德意志帝國、奥匈帝國宣战，援助協约國。9月22日廣州國會非常會議承認對德宣戰案。
name: 호법운동

src: 魯迅發表小說《狂人日記》，抨击了中国古代“吃人”的封建思想。詩人蘇曼殊逝。中國科學社遷回國内，設在南京高師。汕头市发生7.2级大地震，1000人死亡。
name: 광인일기 발표

src: 五四運動。蔡元培辭去北京大學校長職。上海發起中國首次大規模罷工。中華革命黨改組為中國國民黨。北洋政府曹汝霖遭彈劾免職
name: 오사운동

src: 爆發京國之爭，教育界做出以北京語音為標準音的決議，在學校推廣新國语。甘肃海原县发生8.5级大地震，是中国有地震记载中最高烈度地震之一，造成234,117到273,400人死亡。西北五马（马家军）联合自治。
name: 해원 대지진

src: 1月，第一个“新文学”社团文学研究会成立。7月，郭沫若、郁达夫等人在日本东京成立创造社。10月，學衡社成立。嚴復逝。孫中山到廣州重建軍政府，稱「非常大總統」、中國共產黨宣告成立。外蒙古建立親苏俄的君主立憲政府，並宣布獨立，而北洋政府未予承认並發布聲明予以谴责。
name: 중국공산당 창당

src: 胡適推行白話文運動。汕头市出现强烈台风，造成6万到10万人死亡。伍廷芳逝。劉伯明逝
name: 백화문운동

src: 《孙文越飞宣言》发表。二七大罢工。孫中山到廣州三建軍政府，準備聯俄容共。中国青年党于巴黎创立。
name: 손문월비선언 발표

src: 中国国民党第一次全国代表大会在广州召开，國共第一次合作（聯俄容共），黃埔軍校設立，组建北伐军。第二次直奉战争。
name: 제1차 국공합작

src: 滇桂战争。孫文在北京病逝，廣州國民政府成立。國立東南大學校長郭秉文被免職。大理市发生了7.0级地震，5000人死亡
name: 전계전쟁

src: 1月4日中国国民党第二次全国代表大会召开。三一八惨案。中山舰事件。5月1日曹錕宣布下野。7月9日蒋介石就职国民革命军总司令；国民革命军在广州誓师北伐。
name: 국민당 2차 전국대표대회

src: 國共第一次合作破裂、南京國民政府成立，寧漢分裂、四一二事變、剿共、中共發動南昌起义，展开武装割据。中共湖南省委发动秋收暴动，失败后中国工农红军进行三灣改編，自此中共确立“党指挥枪”。王國維自殺，其生前著有《人間詞話》。籌設中央研究院。甘肃古浪县发生了7.6级大地震，死亡4万余人。粤桂战争。
name: 국공합작 결렬

src: 湘南暴动。济南惨案。皇姑屯事件。平江起义。蒋介石就任国民政府主席。张学良宣布東北易幟。北伐完成，國民政府初步實現中國統一。
name: 상난 폭동

src: 梁啟超逝。蒋桂战争。中东路事件。陕西大旱，80%的县受灾，估计死亡加逃亡人数达300万。12月28日古田会议召开。
name: 량치차오 별세

src: 3月2日中国左翼作家联盟在上海市成立。3月24日汪精卫担任国民政府主席。中原大戰。中国工农红军第一方面军成立。中央苏区第一次反围剿战争。
name: 중국좌익작가연맹 성립

src: 中国第一辆汽车“民生牌75型”于奉天迫击炮厂下线。九一八事变，江桥抗战，東三省被日本关东军佔領。國民政府開始實行《建國大綱》的訓政時期計劃。中國共產黨在江西瑞京成立中華蘇維埃共和國（1931-1937），主張推翻中華民國國民政府和中國國民黨的統治。中国的几条主要河流如长江、珠江、黄河、淮河等都发生非常巨大的洪水，死亡人数估计到400万人。新疆富蕴县发生了8.0级地震，造成10,000人死亡。
name: 9·18 사변

src: 一二八事變日本攻占上海。3月1日《建国宣言》宣布滿洲國成立，溥仪成为满洲国皇帝。5月5日淞沪停战协定签订。
name: 1·28 사변

src: 长城抗战。巴金在成都著《家》、《春》、《秋》三部曲。中央將北平故宮博物院重要古物南遷。國聯十九國委員會反對承認滿洲國，日本抨擊國聯。福州發生閩變事件，成立「中華共和國」（1933-1934）。四川茂县叠溪镇发生了7.5级大地震，近10,000人死亡。
name: 장성 항전

src: 推行新生活運動。中国工农紅軍放弃瑞金及井冈山根据地，長征開始。沈從文著《邊城》。考古學家黃文弼著《高昌陶集》
name: 신생활운동

src: 中共举行遵義會議（毛澤東逐渐进入中共核心）。夏鼐等發掘殷墟。《为抗日救国告全体同胞书》发表。一二·九运动。
name: 준이회의

src: 两广事变。张学良与楊虎成发动西安事變，兵谏蒋中正以求共同抗日，事变后張學良遭蒋中正軟禁直至晚年。魯迅逝，章炳麟逝，胡漢民逝。
name: 양광사변

src: 7月7日盧溝橋事變，抗日戰爭全面爆發。國共第二次合作，成立「抗日民族統一戰線」。淞滬會戰，8月14日中日首次空戰，獲814空軍大捷。南京保卫战国军大败，随后日军发动南京大屠殺杀害约30万平民，十年建設（1928-1937）結束。
name: 노구교 사변

src: 国军在台儿庄歼灭日军一万余人。日军攻占聊城。3月28日中华民国维新政府成立。武漢會戰。國民政府遷都陪都重慶，组重庆国民政府。
name: 타이얼좡 전투

src: 日軍轰炸重慶、潼關、洛陽、襄陽、西安、宜昌、泉州、成都等地。裴文中发现北京人头盖骨化石。9月，為紀念淞滬會戰中日首次空戰814空軍大捷，國民政府正式下令8月14日為空軍節。天津发生大水灾。
name: 충칭 대공습

src: 3月30日汪精衛於南京成立傀儡政权（南京国民政府），发表《和平建国十大政纲》。5月1日枣宜会战开始。12月30日延安新華廣播電台開始播音。
name: 왕징웨이 정권 수립

src: 皖南事变。太平洋戰爭（1941-1945）起。12月9日國民政府对納粹德国、意大利王國及日本帝國宣戰；「滿洲國」對美、英宣戰。陈纳德“飞虎队”入华作战。
name: 완난사변

src: 中國遠征軍入緬作戰起，投入兵力總計40萬人，傷亡接近20萬人。5月15日浙赣会战开始，5月28日金华沦陷。
name: 중국원정군 참전

src: 1月9日南京汪精卫政府向英国美國宣戰，日、汪聯合發表《日華共同宣言》、締結《交还租界及撤废治外法权协定书》。中、美、英三盟國在開羅發表對日作戰的開羅宣言。
name: 카이로 선언

src: 豫湘桂會戰。盟軍轟炸機首次從成都起飛轟炸日本本土及日軍佔領區，共1614架次。11月10日汪精卫逝。
name: 예상계회전

src: 中共七大召開，毛澤東當選中國共產黨中央委員會主席。苏联武装军事占领滿洲地区。國軍陸軍總司令何應欽將軍代表同盟國在南京市接受日軍投降，抗日戰爭結束。因受降接收问题发生国共冲突，國共和談後簽訂雙十協定。中華民國國民政府根据中蘇友好同盟條約，宣布承認外蒙古獨立，并隨後表示支持蒙古人民共和國加入聯合國。昆明五华山事件。
name: 일본 항복

src: 1月5日承认外蒙古独立。第二次國共內戰起。詩人聞一多被殺。《中華民國憲法》通過。《中美友好通商航海条约》签订。
name: 외몽골 독립 승인

src: 《中華民國憲法》公布，正式施行憲政。国民革命军实行軍隊國家化，改称中華民國國軍。北塔山事件。鲁南战役。中华民国国军攻入延安。臺灣發生二二八事件。
name: 중화민국헌법 공포

src: 蔣中正當選行憲後第一任中華民國總統，國民政府改组成立中華民國政府。金圓券風暴。上海《观察》杂志被查封。中国人民解放军通过三大战役（三大会战）重创中华民国国军，国共双方军事实力反转。
name: 장제스 총통 취임

src: 中華民國總統蔣中正「下野」。紫石英号事件。中華民國先遷都廣州，随后解放军攻占南京，再遷都重慶，接著在不足半月內遷都成都。台灣省政府主席兼台灣省警備總司令陳誠頒布台灣省戒嚴令。美軍放棄青島基地。中华人民共和国成立并定都北京。金門古寧頭戰役。中華民國政府遷都臺北。發行新台幣，取代舊台幣。西南战役。
name: 중화인민공화국 성립

src: 朝鮮戰爭（1950-1953）爆發，美國派遣第七艦隊巡弋台灣海峽。陳儀在台北被處決。
name: 한국전쟁 발발

src: 日本與美國等48國簽訂《舊金山和約》，聲明放棄對台灣、澎湖的主權。中国人民解放军进驻西藏地区。
name: 샌프란시스코 강화조약

src: 刘青山、张子善被执行枪决，引发了三反五反运动的高潮。4月28日《中華民國與日本國間和平條約》在臺北簽訂。7月25日澳门关闸冲突。
name: 삼반오반운동

src: 中华人民共和国第一次全国人口普查。7月16日東山島戰役。7月27日朝鲜停战协定签订。周恩来提出和平共处五项原则。
name: 정전협정 체결

src: 长江洪水。蔣中正當選第二任中華民國總統。九三炮战。7月23日国泰航空民航客机遭解放军空军击落。
name: 창장 대홍수

src: 2月1日《人民日报》公布第一批230个简化字。5月2日毛泽东提出“双百方针”。4月25日毛泽东作《论十大关系》讲话。“三大改造”基本完成。國立清華大學在台復校。中国第一批量产汽车解放牌汽车于中国第一汽车制造厂完成组装。
name: 간체자 발표

src: 整风运动。反右运动。5月7日美国鬥牛士导弹部署台湾。5月24日美國駐台北大使館遭群眾破坏。
name: 반우파운동

src: 全國性三年大饑荒。藏区骚乱，第十四世达赖喇嘛流亡印度。4月27日，刘少奇当选中华人民共和国主席。7月2日庐山会议召开。台湾中南部八七水災。空喀山口事件。
name: 대약진 대기근

src: 美国总统艾森豪威尔访问中华民国台湾。台湾中横公路正式通车。东风一号，第一枚近程导弹发射成功。
name: 아이젠하워 방문

src: 台湾第一座核子反应堆建成。8月15日中国第一条电气化铁路宝鸡至凤州段通车运营。10月27日聯合國大會通過决議，蒙古人民共和國加入聯合國，中華民國未出席。
name: 대만 핵반응로 완공

src: 毛泽东在七千人大会上作自我批评。中印边境战争。10月12日中朝边界条约签订。台灣電視公司開播。胡適逝世。
name: 중인 국경전쟁

src: 全国开展学雷锋活动。四清运动。8月海河特大洪灾。九评苏共。香港中文大学成立。
name: 사청운동

src: 湖口兵变。第一颗原子弹爆炸成功。麥克阿瑟公路通車。6月14日石門水庫峻工典礼。
name: 후커우 병변

src: 3月5日陳誠逝世。6月30日美援中止。八六海战。9月1日西藏自治区成立。11月10日姚文元发表评新编历史剧《海瑞罢官》。
name: 천청 별세

src: 二月抗争。6月17日首枚氢弹爆炸。台北市升格為直轄市。10月17日溥仪逝世。
七里沁岛事件。10月31日刘少奇被开除中共党籍。12月22日毛泽东发起上山下乡运动。
name: 치리친다오 사건

src: 2月24日远东航空104号班机空难。尼木事件。珍宝岛事件。10月31日中国电视公司开播。11月12日刘少奇去世。
name: 극동항공 104편 사고

src: 泰源事件。4月24日东方红一号发射。4月25蔣經國在美國遭槍擊。12月26日第一艘核潜艇下水。
name: 타이위안 사건

src: 3月26日澎湖跨海大桥通车。10月25日联合国大会2758号决议承认中华人民共和国为中国代表，取代中華民國行使在聯合國的一切合法權利。九一三事件。
name: 펑후대교 개통

src: 尼克松访华，发表《中美联合公报》。日本與中華民國斷交，与中华人民共和国发表《中日联合声明》，建立外交关系。
name: 닉슨 방중

src: 1月18日江青、王洪文等發起「批林批孔運動」。1月19日西沙之战。2月22日毛泽东提出“三个世界”的理论。
name: 비림비공운동

src: 邓小平任中共中央副主席兼中国人民解放军总参谋长。2月4日海城大地震。4月5日蔣中正逝世。沙甸事件。河南“75·8”水库溃坝。广东八四海难。11月29日第一次回收卫星成功。
name: 덩샤오핑 부주석 취임

src: 7月16日中共十届三中全会召开，邓小平复出。9月19日邓小平提出“拨乱反正”。12月10日恢复高考。
name: 덩샤오핑 복귀

src: 1月1日《新闻联播》首次播出。真理标准大讨论。12月18日中国共产党十一届三中全会召开，提出“对内改革、对外开放”、“解放思想、实事求是”的理论。蔣經國當選第六任中華民國總統。
name: 신문연파 첫 방송

src: 美國與中華民國斷交，与中华人民和国建交。对越自卫反击战。全国人大常委会发表《告台湾同胞书》，停止炮击金门。12月10日美麗島事件。
name: 미중 수교

src: 中正纪念堂完工。深圳经济特区成立。新竹科学工业园区成立。9月10日趙紫陽接替華國鋒出任中華人民共和國國務院總理。
name: 중정기념당 완공

src: 《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》通过。
name: 역사문제결의 통과

src: 中国大陆人口总数突破10亿。
name: 인구 10억 돌파

src: 蔣經國當選第七任中華民國總統。中華人民共和國與英國簽署《中英聯合聲明》。
name: 장징궈 총통 당선

src: 中国民航5109号班机空难。
name: 중국민항 5109편 사고

src: 民主進步黨成立。李遠哲獲得諾貝爾化學獎。八六学潮。
name: 민주진보당 창당

src: 蔣經國逝。赤瓜礁海战。沪杭铁路列车相撞。中国民航301号班机空难。9月29日首枚中子弹实弹爆炸。
name: 장징궈 별세

src: 胡耀邦病逝。八九民運。六四清场。中共十三届五中全会江泽民就任中共中央总书记和中央军委主席；改革开放暂缓。《中华人民共和国集会游行示威法》出台。中国东方航空5510号班机空难。中国国际航空981号班机劫机事件。
name: 6·4 톈안먼 사건

src: 李登輝當選第八任中華民國總統。台湾爆发野百合學運。《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法》正式颁布。北京亚运会。中华人民共和国与新加坡共和国建交。上海证券交易所与深圳证券交易所先后成立。
name: 리덩후이 총통 당선

src: 江青自杀。中華民國廢止《動員戡亂時期臨時條款》。
name: 장칭 자살

src: 邓小平南巡。李洪志创立法轮功。大韩民国与中华人民和国建交，与中华民国断交。上海市浦东新区成立。
name: 남순강화

src: 3月31日千岛湖事件。6月6日中国西北航空2303号班机空难。11月27日阜新市艺苑歌舞厅火灾
name: 첸다오호 사건

src: 5月1日開始實行五天工作制。李登輝訪美。
第三次台灣海峽危機。中華民國舉行首次總統直選，李登辉、连战当选首任民选正副总统。
name: 제3차 대만해협 위기

src: 2月19日邓小平逝。7月1日香港主權移交至中華人民共和國。亚洲金融风暴。
name: 덩샤오핑 별세

src: 3月17日朱镕基就任中华人民共和国国务院总理。長江大水。
name: 주룽지 총리 취임

src: 李登輝提出兩國論。中共镇压法轮功。921大地震。澳门政權移交至中華人民共和國。
name: 양국론 제기

src: 武汉航空343号班机空难。陈水扁、吕秀莲当选中華民國正、副总统，民主進步黨首次执政。
name: 우한항공 343편 사고

src: 南海撞机事件。天安门自焚事件。张学良逝。北京举办夏季世界大学生运动会。中华人民共和国加入世界贸易组织。
name: 남중국해 공중충돌 사건

src: 中華民國以「臺澎金馬個別關稅領域」加入世界贸易组织。中国人民解放军首次环球航行。爆发严重急性呼吸道综合征疫情（SARS）。中共十六大召开，胡锦涛接任中国共产党中央委员会总书记。
name: 중화민국 WTO 가입

src: 3月15日胡锦涛当选中华人民共和国主席，温家宝当选中华人民共和国国务院总理。10月15日，太空人楊利偉乘坐神舟五號順利完成了中國第一次載人航天飛行任務。
name: 후진타오 국가주석 취임

src: 三一九枪击事件。陈水扁连任中华民国总统。11月21日中国东方航空5210号班机空难。
name: 3·19 총격 사건

src: 1月8日中越北部湾冲突。反日示威活动。三二六护台湾大游行。作家巴金逝世。
name: 중베트남 통킹만 충돌

src: 2月27日国家统一纲领终止。7月1日青藏铁路全线通车。百万人民倒扁运动。
name: 국가통일강령 종료

src: 台灣高速鐵路1月5日通車。曾荫权当选香港第三届行政长官。
name: 타이완 고속철도 개통

src: 馬英九當選中華民國總統。汶川大地震。北京夏季奥运会。9月27日翟志刚步出神舟七号成为首个太空行走的中国宇航员。
name: 마잉주 총통 당선

src: 哈爾濱舉行第二十四屆冬季大學生運動會。乌鲁木齐七五事件。八八水災。
name: 하얼빈 유니버시아드

src: 中国―东盟自由贸易区启动。海峽兩岸經濟合作架構協議（ECFA）簽訂。上海舉辦世界博覽會。臺北縣升格為新北市，臺南縣市、高雄縣市、臺中縣市分別合併升格為直轄市。
name: 중국-아세안 FTA 출범

src: 1月1日中俄原油管道投入运行。中國國內生產總值超越日本成為全球第二大經濟體。蓬莱19-3油田溢油事故。深圳举办世界大学生夏季运动会。10月10日，中華民國100年國慶。
name: 중국 GDP 일본 추월

src: 馬英九當選第13任總統。第8屆立委選舉。薄熙来、周永康等被捕。11月15日，習近平當選中國共產黨中央委員會總書記及中國共產黨中央軍事委員會主席。
name: 마잉주 총통 당선

src: 4月20日芦山地震。洪仲丘事件。臺紐經濟合作協定（ANZTEC）、臺星經濟合作協定（ASTEP）簽訂。
name: 루산 지진

src: 3月1日昆明火车站恐怖袭击。香港雨傘革命。台灣太陽花學運。7月23日复兴航空222号班机空难。九合一選舉。
name: 쿤밍역 테러

src: 蔡英文當選總統。2月8日旺角骚乱。高雄美濃地震。
name: 차이잉원 총통 당선

src: 3月17日高雄三民區下水道火警事故。815全臺大停電。
name: 8·15 타이완 대정전

src: 中華民國直轄市長及縣市長選舉
name: 직할시장·현시장 선거

src: 嫦娥四号在月球背面的冯·卡门撞击坑内软着陆。香港反對逃犯條例修訂草案運動。中華民國同性婚姻合法化。武汉新冠疫情爆发。
name: 창어 4호 달착륙

src: 中國大陸各地因疫情進入封閉管理狀態。蔡英文连任中华民国总统。《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》颁布。中国南方水灾。李登輝逝。嫦娥五号从月面带回岩石和土壤。
name: 홍콩 국가안전법 시행

src: 《中华人民共和国民法典》实施。6月17日神舟十二号发射，三名航天员进驻天和核心舱。11月18日驻立陶宛台湾代表处挂牌成立。
name: 중국 민법전 시행

src: 北京举办第二十四届冬季奥林匹克运动会。东航坠机事件。上海封城。中共二十大举行，习近平连任中共中央总书记，开始其最高领导人的第三个任期。中华民国举行2022年九合一選舉。中国大陆各地爆发反对动态清零的抗议活动。12月，新冠清零政策终止，中國大陸逐步解封。中共第三代领导核心、前中共中央总书记江澤民逝世。
name: 베이징 동계올림픽

src: 习近平再度连任中国国家主席，成为自1949年中华人民共和国成立以来，首位开展第三个任期的国家元首。河北水灾。李克强逝世。
name: 시진핑 3연임

src: 賴清德當選中華民國總統。香港特别行政区《维护国家安全条例》刊宪生效。嫦娥六号从月背带回岩石和土壤。
name: 라이칭더 총통 당선

src: “神舟二十号”成功發射。
name: 선저우 20호 발사

src: H. sapiens appears in modern Dao County, Hunan.
name: 다오현 호모사피엔스 출현

src: Pigs were first domesticated in China.
name: 돼지 가축화

src: Rice was first domesticated in China.
name: 벼 재배화

src: The Jiahu symbols were first used at Jiahu.
name: 자후 계각부호 사용

src: Dogs were first domesticated in China.
name: 개 가축화

src: Symbols were carved into pottery at Banpo.
name: 반포 토기 부호

src: Silk processing was invented by the Yangshao culture.
name: 비단 가공법 발명

src: Silk was produced by the Liangzhu culture.
name: 량주문화 비단 생산

name: 판천 전투

name: 우 임금 치수

name: 구정 주조

src: Tai Kang became king of the Xia dynasty.
name: 태강 즉위

src: Xiang of Xia became king of the Xia dynasty.
name: 상 즉위

src: Xiang was murdered and displaced as king on the orders of the warlord Han Zhuo. His pregnant wife fled the capital Shangqiu.
name: 상왕 시해

src: Xiang's wife gave birth to a son, Shao Kang.
name: 소강 출생

src: The people of Shangqiu welcomed an army loyal to Shao into the city. Han committed suicide.
name: 소강 하나라 복위

src: Bu abdicated in favor of his younger brother Jiong of Xia.
name: 경 즉위

src: Mount Tai earthquake: An earthquake occurred at Mount Tai.
name: 태산 지진

src: Jiong was succeeded by his son Jin of Xia.
name: 근 즉위

src: Jin was succeeded by his cousin, Bu's son Kong Jia.
name: 공갑 즉위

src: Kong was succeeded by his son Gao of Xia.
name: 고 즉위

src: Gao was succeeded by his son Fa of Xia.
name: 발 즉위

src: Fa was succeeded by his son Jie of Xia.
name: 걸 즉위

src: Jie was succeeded by Tang of Shang, marking the beginning of the Shang dynasty.
name: 상나라 건국

src: Battle of Mingtiao: the Shang clan (later Shang dynasty) overthrow the corrupt and last emperor of the Xia dynasty
name: 명조 전투

src: Pan Geng became king of the Shang dynasty.
name: 반경 즉위

src: The capital of the Shang dynasty was moved from Yan to Yin.
name: 은 천도

src: Wu Ding became king of the Shang dynasty.
name: 무정 즉위

src: Oracle bones were first used for divination; evidence of oracle bone script first appears.
name: 갑골 점복 시작

src: Wu's wife, the general and high priestess Fu Hao, died and was buried at the tomb of Fu Hao in Yinxu.
name: 부호 사망

src: Wu died. He was succeeded by his son Zu Geng of Shang.
name: 무정 사망

src: Geng Ding became king of the Shang dynasty.
name: 경정 즉위

src: Geng was succeeded by his son Wu Yi of Shang.
name: 무을 즉위

src: Wu was killed by lightning while out hunting. He was succeeded by his son Wen Ding.
name: 무을 사망

src: Wen was succeeded by his son Di Yi.
name: 제을 즉위

src: Di was succeeded as king of the Shang dynasty by his son King Zhou of Shang.
name: 주왕 즉위

src: Zhou took Daji as his concubine.
name: 달기 책봉

src: Zhou committed suicide by burning himself with his jewels on the Deer Terrace Pavilion.
name: 주왕 분신자살

src: Wu was succeeded by his son King Cheng of Zhou.
name: 주 성왕 즉위

src: Cheng was succeeded by his son King Kang of Zhou.
name: 주 강왕 즉위

src: King Mu of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 목왕 즉위

src: Mu led an unsuccessful expedition against the Quanrong.
name: 견융 정벌 실패

src: Mu died. He was succeeded by his son King Gong of Zhou.
name: 주 공왕 즉위

src: Gong's son Ji Jian, King Yi of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 의왕 즉위

src: Ji Jian's uncle, Mu's son King Xiao of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 효왕 즉위

src: Ji Jian's son Ji Xie, King Yi of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 이왕 즉위

src: Ji Xie's son King Li of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 여왕 즉위

src: A popular revolt forced Li into exile near Linfen.
name: 국인폭동

src: Li's son King Xuan of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 선왕 즉위

src: Xuan's son King You of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 유왕 즉위

src: You took Bao Si as his concubine.
name: 포사 책봉

src: The Marquess of Shen, whose daughter had been replaced by Bao Si as queen, led an attack on Haojing in alliance with the Quanrong. You and Bao's son Bofu were killed.
name: 호경 함락

src: You's son King Ping of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 평왕 즉위

src: Ping moved the Zhou capital east to Luoyang.
name: 낙읍 천도

src: Ping's grandson King Huan of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 환왕 즉위

src: Battle of Xuge: Huan, in coalition with the Zhou vassal states Chen, Cai and Wey, led a punitive expedition against Zheng. The coalition was defeated and Huan was wounded.
name: 허 전투

src: Huan's son King Zhuang of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 장왕 즉위

src: Duke Huan of Qi became duke of Qi.
name: 제 환공 즉위

src: Zhuang's son King Xi of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 희왕 즉위

src: Xi's son King Hui of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 혜왕 즉위

src: Xiang's son King Qing of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 경왕 즉위

src: Qing's son King Kuang of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 광왕 즉위

src: Kuang's brother King Ding of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 정왕 즉위

src: Knife money came into use.
name: 명도전 사용

src: Ding's son King Jian of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 간왕 즉위

src: Battle of Yanling: A numerically superior Chu force was defeated by Jin in modern Yanling County. King Gong of Chu was injured.
name: 언릉 전투

src: Jian's son King Ling of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 영왕 즉위

src: The earliest surviving reference to Go appeared.
name: 바둑 최초 기록

src: The Chinese people were first divided into a caste system of four occupations.
name: 사농공상 신분제 확립

src: The Zheng prime minister Zichan established the state's first written civil code.
name: 자산 성문법 제정

src: Ji Gui died. He was succeeded by his son King Dao of Zhou.
name: 주 도왕 즉위

src: Dao was murdered by his brother.
name: 도왕 시해

src: Dao's brother Ji Gai, King Jing of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 경왕 즉위

src: The Wu king Liao was killed by the assassin Zhuan Zhu.
name: 오왕 요 암살

src: King Helü of Wu became king of Wu.
name: 오왕 합려 즉위

src: Battle of Boju: Wu decisively defeated a numerically superior Chu force at Boju.
name: 백거 전투

src: Cast iron was first invented in China.
name: 무쇠 발명

src: The Wu king King Fuchai of Wu ordered the building of the Han Canal.
name: 한구 운하 건설

src: The Yue king King Goujian of Yue captured the Wu capital in a surprise assault.
name: 오나라 수도 함락

src: The generally agreed upon date of Confucius' death.
name: 공자 별세

src: Ji Gai's son King Yuan of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 원왕 즉위

src: Wu was annexed by Yue.
name: 오나라 멸망

src: Yuan's son King Zhending of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 정정왕 즉위

src: Zhending died. He was succeeded by his son King Ai of Zhou.
name: 주 애왕 즉위

src: Ai was murdered and succeeded as king by his younger brother King Si of Zhou.
name: 주 사왕 즉위

src: Si was murdered by his brother King Kao of Zhou.
name: 주 사왕 시해

src: Kao became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 고왕 즉위

src: The tomb of Marquis Yi of Zeng was constructed.
name: 증후 을 묘 조성

src: Kao's son King Weilie of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 위열왕 즉위

src: Partition of Jin: Weilie recognized the Jin nobles Marquess Wen of Wei, Marquess Lie of Zhao and Marquess Jing of Han as marquesses, granting de jure independence from Jin to the states of Wei, Zhao and Han.
name: 삼가분진

src: Weilie's son King An of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 안왕 즉위

src: The earliest surviving Chinese maps appeared.
name: 중국 지도 최초 등장

src: The first Chinese star catalogue was compiled.
name: 중국 항성 목록 편찬

src: The city of Handan was founded to serve as the Zhao capital.
name: 한단 축성

src: The Chu prime minister Wu Qi was murdered by nobles at the funeral of its king King Dao of Chu.
name: 오기 피살

src: An's son King Lie of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 열왕 즉위

src: Zheng was annexed by Han.
name: 정나라 멸망

src: Lie's brother King Xian of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 현왕 즉위

src: Duke Xiao of Qin became duke of Qin.
name: 진 효공 즉위

src: Xiao's adviser Shang Yang implemented a legal code in Qin based on the Canon of Laws which established punishment for complicity in a crime, established a system of military ranks, and implemented policies encouraging the cultivation of unsettled land.
name: 상앙 변법

src: Battle of Guiling: Wei laid siege to the Zhao capital Handan.
name: 계릉 전투

src: Battle of Guiling: The Wei army fled Handan in response to reports of a Qi attack on their capital Daliang and were defeated by Qi forces at Guiling, in modern Changyuan County.
name: 계릉 전투

src: The crossbow was first used in China.
name: 쇠뇌 최초 사용

src: Xiao died. He was succeeded by his son King Huiwen of Qin.
name: 진 혜문왕 즉위

src: Shang and his family were executed by dismemberment on charges of treason.
name: 상앙 처형

src: Xian's son King Shenjing of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 신정왕 즉위

src: The Confucian Mencius became a Qi official.
name: 맹자 제나라 출사

src: Shu was conquered and annexed by Qin.
name: 촉 정복

src: Ba was conquered and annexed by Qin.
name: 파 정복

src: Shenjing's son King Nan of Zhou became king of the Zhou dynasty.
name: 주 난왕 즉위

src: Huiwen's son King Wu of Qin became king of Qin.
name: 진 무왕 즉위

src: Wu's brother King Zhaoxiang of Qin became king of Qin.
name: 진 소양왕 즉위

src: Zou Yan was born. The Tsinghua Bamboo Slips were written.
name: 추연 출생

src: Battle of Yique: Qin dealt a bloody defeat to a Wei-Han alliance.
name: 이궐 전투

src: Qin conquered the Chu capital Ying.
name: 영 함락

src: The Chu poet Qu Yuan wrote Lament for Ying and drowned himself in the Miluo River because he could not bear his exile any long or to his despair for the state of his fellow countrymen
name: 굴원 투신

src: April — Battle of Changping: Zhao intercepted a Qin invasion of the commandery of Shangdang .
name: 장평 대전

src: July — Battle of Changping: Qin forces encircled the Zhao army, forcing its surrender. The Zhao general Zhao Kuo was killed in action.
name: 장평대전 항복

src: July — Battle of Changping: The captured Zhao soldiers were executed.
name: 장평 대학살

src: February — Qin Shi Huang is born.
name: 진시황 출생

src: Nan submitted to Zhaoxiang and took the title Duke of West Zhou.
name: 주 난왕 항복

src: Nan died. His territory was annexed by Qin.
name: 주나라 멸망

src: The Dujiangyan irrigation system was built.
name: 두장옌 건설

src: The first drawings of the repeating crossbow appeared in Chu records.
name: 연발 쇠뇌 등장

src: September — Zhaoxiang's son King Xiaowen of Qin became king of Qin.
name: 진 효문왕 즉위

src: September — Xiaowen died. He was succeeded by his son King Zhuangxiang of Qin.
name: 진 장양왕 즉위

src: May — Zhuangxiang died. He was succeeded by his son Qin Shi Huang.
name: 진시황제 즉위

src: Qin's wars of unification: Qin invaded Han.
name: 한나라 침공

src: Jing Ke failed in an assassination attempt on Qin Shi Huang.
name: 형가 암살 시도

src: Qin conquered Wei.
name: 위나라 정복

src: Qin conquered Chu.
name: 초나라 정복

src: Qin conquered Yan.
name: 연나라 정복

src: Qin conquered Zhao.
name: 조나라 정복

src: Qin conquered Qi.
name: 제나라 정복

src: Qin Shi Huang took the title Qin Shi Huang, first emperor of China.
name: 황제 칭호 채택

src: Construction began on the Great Wall of China.
name: 만리장성 건설 시작

src: Chancellor Li Si standardized the Chinese writing system with the creation of Small Seal Script.
name: 소전 창제

src: Burning of books and burying of scholars: All copies of the Classic of Poetry, the Book of Documents and works of the Hundred Schools of Thought were ordered burned.
name: 분서갱유

src: September — Qin Shi Huang died from mercury pills made by his alchemists and court physicians; ironically these pills were meant to make Qin Shi Huang immortal.
name: 진시황제 사망

src: Qin Shi Huang was buried with the Terracotta Army in the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor.
name: 진시황릉 매장

src: October — Qin Shi Huang's son Qin Er Shi succeeded him as emperor of China.
name: 진 이세황제 즉위

src: The Xiongnu chanyu Modu Chanyu established the Xiongnu Empire on the Eurasian Steppe.
name: 흉노 제국 건국

src: July — Dazexiang Uprising: Military officers Chen Sheng and Wu Guang began a rebellion for fear of being executed after failing to arrive at their posts.
name: 대택향 봉기

src: December — Dazexiang Uprising: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were assassinated by their own men.
name: 진승·오광 피살

src: Li was executed on charges of treason. Zhao Gao, who had framed him, was appointed chancellor in his stead.
name: 이사 처형

src: Battle of Julu: Chu forces led by the warlord Xiang Yu defeated a numerically superior Qin force, killing a large fraction of the Qin army.
name: 거록 대전

src: October — Zhao Gao had Qin Er Shi killed. Qin Er Shi's nephew Ziying succeeded him.
name: 이세황제 시해

src: The Chu general Emperor Gaozu of Han entered the Qin capital Xianyang.
name: 함양 입성

src: December — Ziying killed Zhao.
name: 조고 피살

src: December — Ziying surrendered to Gaozu.
name: 자영 항복

src: Feast at Hong Gate: Gaozu fled a banquet after it became clear that Xiang had invited him there to be killed.
name: 홍문연

src: Xiang led an army into Xianyang, burned the Epang Palace and killed Ziying and the royal family.
name: 아방궁 소각

src: Battle of Jingxing: Han forces dealt a decisive defeat to a numerically superior Zhao army at Jingxing Pass.
name: 정형 전투

src: The Qin general Zhao Tuo established the state of Nanyue.
name: 남월 건국

src: Gaozu took the title emperor and established his capital in Luoyang.
name: 한나라 건국

src: Battle of Baideng: The Xiongnu encircled and besieged a superior Han force.
name: 백등산 포위전

src: The multi-tube seed drill was invented.
name: 다관식 파종기 발명

src: June — Gaozu died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Hui of Han.
name: 한고조 붕어

src: The Han chancellor Xiao He died.
name: 소하 사망

src: Chang'an became the eastern terminus of the Silk Road to Europe.
name: 비단길 동쪽 종착점

src: Hui died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Qianshao of Han.
name: 혜제 붕어

src: Qianshao was deposed and killed on the orders of the empress dowager Empress Lü Zhi. He was succeeded by his brother Emperor Houshao of Han.
name: 전소제 폐위

src: Lü Clan Disturbance: Houshao was deposed by imperial officials led by Chen Ping and Zhou Bo. He was succeeded by his uncle, Gaozu's son Emperor Wen of Han.
name: 여씨의 난

src: The Mawongdui Silk Texts were buried at Mawongdui.
name: 마왕퇴 백서 매장

src: Summer — Wen died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Jing of Han.
name: 문제 붕어

src: March — Jing died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Wu of Han.
name: 경제 붕어

src: Han campaigns against Minyue: The Han dynasty invaded Minyue after a plea for assistance from its vassal state Nanyue.
name: 한의 민월 정벌

src: Southward expansion of the Han dynasty: The Han dynasty annexed Minyue.
name: 민월 병합

src: Zhang Qian returned to the Han court to report on his travels to the kingdoms of Dayuan, Kangju, the Greco-Bactrian and Indo-Greek Kingdoms, Parthia and Mesopotamia.
name: 장건 귀환

src: January — Battle of Mobei: A Han expedition into the Orkhon Valley began which would deal a decisive and bloody defeat to the Xiongnu.
name: 막북 전투

src: Han campaigns against Minyue: The Minyue rump state of Dongyue was invaded and annexed by the Han dynasty.
name: 동월 병합

src: Han–Nanyue War: The Han dynasty conquered and annexed Nanyue.
name: 한-남월 전쟁

src: Han campaigns against Dian: The Han dynasty invaded and annexed the Dian Kingdom.
name: 한의 전 정벌

src: December — Battle of Loulan: Han forces attacked the Loulan Kingdom at Lop Nur.
name: 누란 전투

src: Han forces laid siege to Kokand.
name: 코칸드 포위

src: Steel was first used in China.
name: 강철 첫 사용

src: March — Wu died. He was succeeded by his young son Emperor Zhao of Han, with Huo Guang, Jin Midi and Shangguang Jie acting as regents.
name: 무제 붕어

src: July — The Prince of Changyi was appointed emperor of Han by Huo Guang.
name: 창읍왕 즉위

src: August — The Prince of Changyi was deposed.
name: 창읍왕 폐위

src: Huo appointed Wu's great-grandson, then a commoner, Emperor Xuan of Han.
name: 한선제 옹립

src: December — Battle of Jushi: Han forces defeated the people of the Gushi culture, at that time subject to the Xiongnu, at Jiaohe in modern Turpan.
name: 차사 전투

src: Xuan's son Emperor Yuan of Han became emperor of the Han dynasty.
name: 한원제 즉위

src: The earliest surviving Chinese record of the treadle-operated tilt hammer appeared.
name: 디딜방아 최초기록

src: December — Battle of Zhizhi: A Han force breached and destroyed a fortress occupied by the Xiongnu chanyu Zhizhi Chanyu at Taraz, killing him.
name: 질지 공성전

src: The earliest surviving mention of the wheelbarrow appeared.
name: 외바퀴 수레 첫 기록

src: Liu Xiang compiled the Biographies of Exemplary Women.
name: 열녀전 편찬

src: Cheng died. He was succeeded by his nephew Emperor Ai of Han.
name: 한 애제 즉위

src: Ai's young cousin Emperor Ping of Han was appointed emperor of the Han dynasty, with Wang Mang acting as regent.
name: 한 평제 즉위

src: The first model of a stern-mounted rudder was produced.
name: 선미 방향타 발명

src: A census counted fifty-nine million people in the Han empire.
name: 한나라 인구조사

src: Ping established a national school system. Ban Biao, first author of the Book of Han, is born.
name: 국가 학교 제도 수립

src: February — Ping died after being poisoned by Wang, who became acting emperor.
name: 평제 독살

src: Liu Xin completed a star catalogue and calculated the length of the year.
name: 유흠 별자리 목록 완성

src: Wang declared himself emperor of the Xin dynasty.
name: 신나라 건국

src: Wang introduced the well-field system of land distribution and agricultural production.
name: 정전제 도입

src: Wang introduced an income tax of ten percent for professionals and skilled laborers.
name: 소득세 도입

src: Wang outlawed the private use of crossbows.
name: 쇠뇌 사용 금지

src: Wang abandoned the well-field system under pressure from the aristocracy.
name: 정전제 폐지

src: Wang imposed government monopolies on liquor, salt, iron, coinage, forestry, and fishing.
name: 국가 전매제 시행

src: Mother Lü initiated a rebellion against a county magistrate in Haiqu County, near modern Rizhao.
name: 여모의 난

src: October — Lülin rebels stormed the Weiyang Palace and killed Wang. The Gengshi Emperor ascended the throne, restoring the Han dynasty.
name: 신나라 멸망

src: Red Eyebrows Rebellions: The Gengshi Emperor was executed.
name: 경시제 처형

src: Red Eyebrows Rebellions: The Red Eyebrows appointed Liu Penzi their emperor.
name: 유분자 옹립

src: August — The Han warlord Emperor Guangwu of Han took the title emperor.
name: 광무제 즉위

src: Red Eyebrows Rebellions: The Red Eyebrows surrendered to the Han dynasty.
name: 적미군 항복

src: Du Shi invented waterwheel-powered bellows for smelting cast iron.
name: 수차 풀무 발명

src: Ban Gu, co-author of the Book of Han, is born.
name: 반고 출생

src: A blockade of the Yangtze River by the rebel Gongsun Shu was broken by Han castle ships.
name: 양쯔강 봉쇄 격파

src: Second Chinese domination of Vietnam: Vietnam fell into Han control.
name: 베트남 한나라 병합

src: Ban Zhao, China's first female historian, is born.
name: 반소 출생

src: March — Guangwu died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Ming of Han.
name: 한 명제 즉위

src: The Han chancellor Deng Yu died.
name: 등우 사망

src: Ming's half brother Liu Ying converted to Buddhism.
name: 유영 불교 개종

src: The Buddhist White Horse Temple was established in Luoyang.
name: 백마사 건립

src: February — Battle of Yiwulu: A punitive Han expedition against the Xiongnu captured territory in the area of modern Hami City.
name: 이오려 전투

src: Ming died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Zhang of Han.
name: 한 장제 즉위

src: Wang Chong correctly theorized the nature of the water cycle.
name: 왕충 물의 순환 이론

src: Zhang died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor He of Han.
name: 한 화제 즉위

name: 알타이산맥 전투

src: The Han general Ban Chao sent the envoy Gan Ying to the outskirts of the Roman Empire.
name: 감영 파견

src: Xu Shen completed the Shuowen Jiezi.
name: 설문해자 완성

src: He's infant son Emperor Shang of Han was made emperor of Han with empress dowager Deng Sui acting as regent.
name: 한 상제 즉위

src: Shang's young cousin Emperor An of Han became emperor, with Deng Sui continuing to act as regent.

src: Ban Zhao completed the Book of Han.
name: 한서 완성

src: Zhang Heng completed a star catalogue which also argued for a spherical moon that reflects light.
name: 장형 별자리 목록 완성

src: Zhang invented the first hydraulic-powered armillary sphere.
name: 혼천의 발명

src: The earliest known Chinese depiction of a mechanical distance-marking odometer was drawn.
name: 오도미터 그림

src: The Marquess of Beixiang became emperor of the Han dynasty.
name: 북향후 즉위

src: Zhang invented a seismometer capable of indicating the direction of earthquakes.
name: 지진계 발명

src: The Cantong qi was published.
name: 주역참동계 간행

src: Shun died. He was succeeded by his infant son Emperor Chong of Han, with empress dowager Liang Na and her brother Liang Ji acting as regents.
name: 후한 충제 즉위

src: Liang Ji poisoned Zhi, killing him.
name: 질제 독살

src: August — Emperor Huan of Han became emperor of the Han dynasty.
name: 후한 환제 즉위

src: The Buddhist missionary An Shigao arrived in China.
name: 안세고 도래

src: Sino-Roman relations: A Roman envoy arrived at the Han capital Luoyang.
name: 로마 사절 낙양 도착

name: 당고의 화

src: Emperor Ling of Han became emperor of the Han dynasty.
name: 후한 영제 즉위

src: The earliest known reference to The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art appeared.
name: 구장산술 최초 언급

src: Ding Huan invented the rotary fan.
name: 회전식 부채 발명

name: 양주의 난

src: Zhi Yao first translated Buddhist texts into Chinese.
name: 불경 한역

src: Ling's son Liu Bian became emperor of the Han dynasty.
name: 유변 즉위

src: Forces loyal to the warlords Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu massacred some two thousand eunuchs in the Han capital Luoyang.
name: 환관 학살

name: 동탁 폐립

name: 동탁 토벌전

src: May — Dong was assassinated by his foster son Lü Bu.
name: 동탁 피살

name: 손책 강동 정벌

name: 관도 대전

src: The warlord Gongsun Kang established the Daifang Commandery on the Korean Peninsula.
name: 대방군 설치

name: 유비 입촉

name: 한수 전투

name: 후한 멸망

src: Liu Bei declared himself emperor of Shu Han.
name: 촉한 건국

src: Battle of Xiaoting: The Shu Han generals Wu Ban and Feng Xi attacked and destroyed an Eastern Wu army at Wu Gorge.
name: 이릉대전

src: Sun Quan declared himself king of Eastern Wu.
name: 손권 칭왕

src: Battle of Xiaoting: Eastern Wu forces attacked and burned the Shu Han camps and dealt serious casualties during their retreat.
name: 이릉대전

name: 유비 사망

src: Autumn — Zhuge Liang's Southern Campaign: The rebel leader Meng Huo surrendered Nanzhong to Zhuge Liang.
name: 제갈량 남정

name: 조예 즉위

name: 오장원 전투

name: 조방 즉위

src: Eastern Wu forces killed the Vietnamese rebel Lady Triệu.
name: 찌에우 부인 피살

name: 고평릉 사변

src: Sun Quan died. He was succeeded by his young son Sun Liang, with the general Zhuge Ke acting as regent.
name: 손량 즉위

src: Sima Yi's son, the regent Sima Shi, deposed Cao Fang, who was succeeded by Cao Pi's grandson Cao Mao.
name: 조모 즉위

src: Sun Liang was deposed by the regent Sun Chen.
name: 손량 폐위

src: Sun Liang's brother Sun Xiu was made emperor of Eastern Wu.
name: 손휴 즉위

src: Coup of Cao Mao: Cao Mao was murdered in a failed attempt to kill the regent Sima Zhao at his residence.
name: 조모의 정변

src: Cao Cao's grandson Cao Huan was made emperor of Cao Wei.
name: 조환 즉위

src: Liu Hui published a revised version of The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art.
name: 구장산술 개정판

src: Sun Quan's grandson Sun Hao was made emperor of Eastern Wu.
name: 손호 즉위

src: Cao Wei instituted the nine-rank system of civil servants.
name: 구품관인법 제정

src: September — Sima Zhao died. His eldest son and heir, Sima Yan, inherited his position as regent of Cao Wei and noble title of King of Jin.
name: 사마염 섭정 계승

src: Pei Xiu introduced the grid reference and the concept of scale to Chinese mapmaking.
name: 방격법과 축척 도입

src: February — Cao Huan, last emperor of Cao Wei, abdicated in favour of Sima Yan.
name: 조환 양위

src: February — Emperor Wu of Jin established his oldest living son, the developmentally disabled Sima Zhong, as Heir.
name: 사마충 태자 책봉

src: March — Conquest of Wu by Jin: Sun Hao presented himself as a prisoner to the Jin general Wang Jun.
name: 진의 오 정복

src: May — Emperor Wu died. He was succeeded by his developmentally disabled son Emperor Hui of Jin, with Yang Jun acting as regent.
name: 사마염 사망

src: The Di warlord Li Xiong declared himself prince of Cheng Han.
name: 이웅 성한 건국

src: January — Hui was poisoned, probably by the regent Sima Yue.
name: 혜제 독살

src: Hui's brother Emperor Huai of Jin became emperor of the Jin dynasty.
name: 회제 즉위

src: Huai was kidnapped from the capital Luoyang by Former Zhao forces.
name: 회제 납치

src: Goguryeo conquered and annexed the Lelang Commandery.
name: 낙랑군 병합

src: March — Huai was executed.
name: 회제 처형

src: Huai's nephew Emperor Min of Jin became emperor of the Jin dynasty.
name: 민제 즉위

src: Min surrendered to the Former Zhao general Liu Yao during a siege of the Jin capital Chang'an.
name: 민제 항복

src: Emperor Yuan of Jin declared himself prince of Jin, with his capital at Jiankang.
name: 동진 건국

src: The Jie warlord Shi Le declared himself prince of Later Zhao.
name: 후조 건국

src: Zhang Mao issued a general pardon to the people of Former Liang.
name: 전량 대사면

src: January — Yuan died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Ming of Jin.
name: 원제 사망

src: October — Ming died. He was succeeded by his young son Emperor Cheng of Jin.
name: 명제 사망

src: The rebel Su Jun was defeated by the Jin generals Tao Kan and Wen Jiao.
name: 소준의 난 진압

src: The Later Zhao general Shi Hu captured Shanggui in modern Tianshui and killed the Former Zhao emperor Liu Xi and his nobility.
name: 상규 점령

src: November — The Xianbei Murong Huang declared himself prince of Former Yan.
name: 전연 건국

src: June — Cheng died. He was succeeded by his brother Emperor Kang of Jin.
name: 성제 사망

src: November — Kang died. He was succeeded by his infant son Emperor Mu of Jin.
name: 강제 사망

src: The Jin general Huan Wen captured the Cheng Han capital Chengdu.
name: 성도 점령

src: The Jin general and Di chief Fu Jian declared himself Tian Wang of Former Qin.
name: 전진 건국

src: The Later Zhao emperor Shi Zhi and his court were killed by one of his generals on the orders of the warlord Ran Min.
name: 석지 시해

src: Mu's cousin Emperor Ai of Jin became emperor of the Jin dynasty.
name: 애제 즉위

src: March — Ai died. He was succeeded by his brother Emperor Fei of Jin.
name: 애제 사망

src: Gu Kaizhi became a Jin officer.
name: 고개지 출사

src: A Jin army led by Huan was annihilated as it retreated from the Former Yan capital Ye by the general Murong Chui.
name: 환온군 전멸

src: The Former Yan emperor Murong Wei was captured by the Former Qin prime minister Wang Meng.
name: 모용위 피랍

src: January — Huan deposed Fei in favor of his granduncle Emperor Jianwen of Jin.
name: 폐제 폐위

src: September — Jianwen died. He was succeeded by his young son Emperor Xiaowu of Jin.
name: 진 효무제 즉위

src: September — Duke Zhang Tianxi of Former Liang surrendered to Former Qin.
name: 장천석 전진 항복

src: November — Battle of Fei River: A Jin army defeated a massively larger Former Qin force, inflicting some seven hundred thousand casualties and expanding Jin territory north to the Yellow River.
name: 비수 대전

src: The Xianbei Former Qin general Murong Chui declared himself prince of Later Yan.
name: 후연 건국

src: The Former Qin general Yao Chang declared himself prince of Later Qin.
name: 후진 건국

src: The Xianbei chief and Former Qin vassal Qifu Guoren joined an active rebellion and declared the independence of Western Qin.

src: February — Emperor Daowu of Northern Wei declared himself prince of Northern Wei.
name: 북위 건국

src: The Former Qin general Lü Guang declared himself Tian Wang of the majority-Di Later Liang.
name: 후량 건국

src: The Former Qin emperor Fu Chong was killed and his territory annexed by Western Qin forces.
name: 전진 멸망

src: Xiaowu was suffocated by one of his concubines. He was succeeded by his young and severely disabled son Emperor An of Jin.

src: Xiongnu rebels established the Northern Liang, with the Han Duan Ye as king.
name: 북량 건국

src: Murong Chui's brother Murong De declared himself prince of Southern Yan.
name: 남연 건국

src: Faxian left for India to acquire Buddhist texts.
name: 법현 인도 순례

src: Six commanderies of Northern Liang seceded as Western Liang, under the kingship of the Han Li Gao.
name: 서량 독립

name: 후량 멸망

src: The Later Qin general Helian Bobo declared himself Tian Wang of the majority-Xiongnu Xia.
name: 하 건국

src: March — The Southern Yan emperor Murong Chao was executed by Jin along with his court and nobility.
name: 남연 멸망

src: Western Qin conquered the Southern Liang capital Ledu, in modern Haidong.
name: 남량 정복

src: The Later Qin emperor Yao Hong surrendered to the Jin general Emperor Wu of Liu Song.
name: 후진 멸망

src: January — An was strangled on Wu's orders and succeeded by his brother Emperor Gong of Jin.
name: 진 공제 즉위

src: Wu deposed Gong, marking the beginning of the Liu Song dynasty.
name: 유송 건국

src: The Western Liang prince Li Xun committed suicide during the siege of his capital Dunhuang by Northern Liang.
name: 서량 멸망

src: Summer — The Western Qin prince Qifu Mumo was executed along with his nobility by the Xia emperor Helian Ding.
name: 서진 멸망

src: June — The Northern Yan emperor Feng Hong fled the capital Helong in the face of an attack by Northern Wei.
name: 풍홍 화룡 탈출

src: Juqu Anzhou, the prince of Northern Liang in exile in Gaochang, was killed with his family by the Rouran Khaganate.
name: 북량 멸망

src: Bodhidharma arrived in China.
name: 달마 중국 도래

src: The oldest known painted depiction of a horse collar was made in the Mogao Caves.
name: 말목걸이 벽화

src: The Liu Song emperor Emperor Shun of Liu Song was deposed by his general Emperor Gao of Southern Qi.
name: 남제 건국

src: The Northern Wei emperor Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei introduced the equal-field system.
name: 균전제 도입

src: Change of Xianbei names to Han names: Xianbei names were converted to Han names in Northern Wei.
name: 선비 성씨 한화

src: The young Southern Qi emperor Emperor He of Southern Qi was deposed by his general Emperor Wu of Liang.
name: 양 건국

src: The Northern Wei emperor Emperor Xiaowu of Northern Wei fled the capital Luoyang to Chang'an at the advance of his general Gao Huan.
name: 효무제 장안 도피

src: Gao Huan appointed Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei emperor of Eastern Wei with his capital at Ye.
name: 동위 건국

src: June — The Eastern Wei general Emperor Wenxuan of Northern Qi deposed Xiaojing and established the state of Northern Qi.
name: 북제 건국

src: The Liang general Emperor Wu of Chen deposed the emperor Emperor Jing of Liang, establishing the Chen dynasty.
name: 진 건국

src: February — The Western Wei general Yuwen Hu deposed the emperor Emperor Gong of Western Wei in favor of his own cousin Emperor Xiaomin of Northern Zhou, establishing the successor state of Northern Zhou.
name: 북주 건국

src: February — The Northern Qi emperor Gao Heng and his father, the Taishang Huang Gao Wei, were executed with their family by Northern Zhou.
name: 북제 황족 처형

src: The Northern Zhou emperor Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou was forced to abdicate in favor of his regent Emperor Wen of Sui, initiating the Sui dynasty.
name: 수 건국

src: Compilation began of the Jingdian Shiwen.
name: 경전석문 편찬

src: Yan Zhitui first referred to toilet paper.
name: 화장지 최초 언급

src: February — Sui forces captured the Chen capital Jiankang and its emperor Chen Shubao.
name: 수의 중국 통일

src: Sui–Former Lý War: Sui conquered and annexed the Early Lý dynasty.
name: 수-전기 리 전쟁

src: August — Wen died. He was succeeded by his son Emperor Yang of Sui.
name: 수 문제 사망

src: The imperial examination was first used as the sole criterion for appointing local officials in Sui.
name: 과거제 시행

src: Japanese missions to Sui China: The Wa emissary Ono no Imoko arrived in Sui.
name: 견수사

src: Engineers Geng Xun and Yuwen Kai invented an improved water clock.
name: 물시계 발명

src: Yang ordered his commanderies to submit maps and gazetteers to the central government.
name: 지방지 제출 명령

src: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas first visited China.
name: 사드 이븐 와카스 방문

src: December — The rebel Emperor Gaozu of Tang, in control of the Sui capital Chang'an, declared Yang Taishang Huang and his grandson Yang You emperor.
name: 양유 옹립

src: June — Transition from Sui to Tang: Gaozu deposed Yang You.
name: 수말당초

src: Ouyang Xun completed the Yiwen Leiju.
name: 예문유취 완성

src: July — Xuanwu Gate Incident: Gaozu's son Emperor Taizong of Tang assassinated his brothers Li Yuanji and the crown prince Li Jiancheng.
name: 현무문의 변

src: September — Gaozu retired. Taizong succeeded him.
name: 당 태종 즉위

src: The first Christian missionaries arrived in China.
name: 그리스도교 선교사 도착

src: Nestorian monks from Anatolia and the Sasanian Empire built the Daqin Pagoda.
name: 대진탑 건립

src: Alopen wrote the Jesus Sutras.
name: 예수경 저술

src: Emperor Taizong's campaign against Tuyuhun: The Tuyuhun khan Murong Fuyun, in flight from Tang forces and with much of his army destroyed, was killed by his officers.
name: 당 태종의 토욕혼 정벌

src: The Book of Chen, Book of Northern Qi, Book of Zhou, and Book of Sui were compiled.
name: 사서 편찬

src: Tibetan attack on Songzhou: Tibetan forces raided the city of Songzhou, in modern Songpan County.
name: 토번의 송주 공격

src: Tang campaign against Karakhoja: Tang defeated and annexed Gaochang.
name: 고창 병합

src: Emperor Taizong's campaign against Xueyantuo: Taizong sent his general Li Shiji to support the restoration of the Eastern Turkic Khaganate under Qilibi Khan against Xueyantuo.
name: 당 태종의 설연타 정벌

src: Taizong commissioned Yan Liben to paint portraits of his officials at Lingyan Pavilion.
name: 능연각 초상화 제작

src: Tang campaigns against Karasahr: A Tang army captured Karasahr and installed a friendly king.
name: 카라샤르 정벌

src: July — First campaign in the Goguryeo–Tang War: Tang forces dispersed a Goguryeo army which had arrived in defense of Ansi City.
name: 고구려-당 전쟁

src: Bianji compiled the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions.
name: 대당서역기 편찬

src: Tang campaigns against Karasahr: Tang forces captured the king of Karasahr.
name: 카라샤르 왕 포로

src: The four arts were first written of as skills required of a Chinese scholar-official.
name: 사예 첫 기록

src: January — Tang campaign against Kucha: Kucha surrendered to Tang forces.
name: 구자 항복

src: July — Taizong's son Emperor Gaozong of Tang became emperor of the Tang dynasty.
name: 당 고종 즉위

src: Gaozong commissioned the compilation of a materia medica.
name: 본초서 편찬 명령

src: Battle of Irtysh River: Tang forces ambushed and largely destroyed the army of the Western Turkic Khaganate at the Irtysh River.
name: 이르티시 강 전투

src: The Chinese Buddhist monks Zhiyu and Zhiyou crafted a mechanical south-pointing chariot for the Japanese emperor Emperor Tenji.
name: 지남거 제작

src: October — Gaozong's wife Wu Zetian became emperor of the Tang dynasty. She was the only generally recognized female emperor in Chinese history.
name: 측천무후 즉위

src: Tang forces reconquered the Four Garrisons of Anxi from Tibet.
name: 안서사진 탈환

src: February — Wu Zetian was forced to abdicate the throne in favor of her son Emperor Zhongzong of Tang.
name: 측천무후 퇴위

src: February — Zhongzong became emperor of Tang.
name: 당 중종 즉위

src: July — Zhongzong died after being poisoned, probably by his wife Empress Wei.
name: 당 중종 독살

src: July — Zhongzong's son Emperor Shang of Tang became emperor of Tang, with Wei acting as regent.
name: 당 상제 즉위

src: July — A coup led by Gaozong's daughter Princess Taiping and grandson Emperor Xuanzong of Tang killed Wei and deposed Shang in favor of his uncle, Gaozong's son Emperor Ruizong of Tang.
name: 당륭정변

src: September — Ruizong abdicated the throne to Xuanzong.
name: 예종 양위

src: The Kaiyuan Za Bao was first published.
name: 개원잡보 발간

src: First encounter between the Tang dynasty and the Umayyad Arabs. Tang dynasty defeats the Arab occupation force in Fergana Valley, reinstalls Ikhshid on the throne.
name: 페르가나 전투

src: Arabs attack Transoxiana hoping to capture the Tang dynasty's Four Garrisons of Anxi district, but are routed in the Battle of Aksu.
name: 아크수 전투

src: Yi Xing invented a water-powered armillary sphere.
name: 수력 혼천의 발명

src: Gautama Siddha completed the compilation of the Treatise on Astrology of the Kaiyuan Era.
name: 개원점경 편찬

src: Du Fu and Li Bai first met.
name: 두보·이백 첫 만남

src: December — An Lushan Rebellion: The Tang jiedushi An Lushan declared himself emperor of Yan.
name: 안사의 난

src: Spring — Battle of Yongqiu: Yan forces retreated from their siege of a Tang fortress in Yongqiu, in modern Kaifeng.
name: 옹구 전투

src: August — The Tang army declared Xuanzong's son Emperor Suzong of Tang emperor at Lingwu.
name: 숙종 즉위

src: September — Xuanzong recognized Suzong as emperor.
name: 숙종 즉위 승인

name: 수양 전투

src: Arab and Persian pirates looted and burned the Tang seaport of Guangzhou.
name: 광저우 약탈

src: Yangzhou massacre (760): Arab and Persian merchants are killed by Chinese rebels.
name: 양저우 학살

src: May — Suzong died of a heart attack.
name: 숙종 사망

src: May — Suzong's son Emperor Daizong of Tang became emperor of the Tang dynasty.
name: 대종 즉위

src: An Lushan Rebellion: The Yan emperor Shi Chaoyi committed suicide in flight from Tang forces.
name: 안사의 난 종결

src: June — Daizong's son Emperor Dezong of Tang became emperor of the Tang dynasty.
name: 덕종 즉위

src: The Nestorian Stele was composed.
name: 대진경교유행중국비 건립

src: Red Turban Rebellion: The rebel army captured Nanjing.

src: October — Battle of Lake Poyang: The Han navy was destroyed. Chen Youliang was killed.
name: 진우량 전사

name: 원 혜종 대도 탈출

name: 금의위 설치

src: A legal code based on the Tang Code was implemented in Ming.

src: June — The Hongwu Emperor's young grandson the Jianwen Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 건문제 즉위

src: July — Jingnan Campaign: Forces loyal to the Jianwen Emperor's uncle the Yongle Emperor entered the capital Nanjing and burned the imperial palace with the Jianwen Emperor inside.
name: 정난의 변

src: July — Treasure voyages: The Yongle Emperor ordered a fleet of Chinese treasure ships under the command of the admiral Zheng He to reestablish tributary relationships with states in the South China Sea and Indian Ocean.
name: 정화의 원정

src: Construction began on the Forbidden City and Beijing city fortifications.
name: 자금성 건설 착수

src: April — The Kagyu karmapa Deshin Shekpa, 5th Karmapa Lama arrived at the Ming capital Nanjing.
name: 데신 셱파 남경 도착

name: 명·호 전쟁

src: Restoration work on the Grand Canal was completed.
name: 대운하 복구 완료

src: Construction of the Forbidden City and Beijing city fortifications was completed. The Yongle Emperor moved the Ming capital from Nanjing to Beijing.
name: 북경 천도

src: September — The Yongle Emperor's son the Hongxi Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 홍희제 즉위

src: May — The Hongxi Emperor died, probably from a heart attack.
name: 홍희제 사망

src: June — The Hongxi Emperor's son the Xuande Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 선덕제 즉위

src: Ming recognized the Lê dynasty as a tributary state.
name: 여 왕조 조공국 인정

src: February — The Xuande Emperor's son the Zhengtong Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 정통제 즉위

src: September — The Zhengtong Emperor's brother the Jingtai Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 경태제 즉위

src: February — The Zhengtong Emperor overthrew the Jingtai Emperor in a coup and took power as the Tianshun Emperor.
name: 탈문의 변

src: August — Rebellion of Cao Qin: An uprising of Mongol soldiers in the Ming capital Beijing, led by the general Cao Qin, was crushed.
name: 조흠의 변

src: February — The Zhengtong Emperor died.
name: 정통제 사망

src: February — The Zhengtong Emperor's son the Chenghua Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 성화제 즉위

src: The Miao and Yao peoples rebelled against Ming authority in Guangxi.
name: 묘요족 반란

src: September — The Chenghua Emperor died.
name: 성화제 사망

src: September — The Chenghua Emperor's son the Hongzhi Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 홍치제 즉위

src: The Joseon official Choe Bu suffered a shipwreck in Zhejiang.
name: 최부 표류 사건

src: June — The Hongzhi Emperor died.
name: 홍치제 사망

src: June — The Hongzhi Emperor's son the Zhengde Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 정덕제 즉위

src: August — Capture of Malacca: A Portuguese invasion force conquered the Malacca Sultanate, the news reached the Ming.
name: 말라카 함락

src: The Portuguese explorer Jorge Álvares arrived on Lintin Island in the Pearl River Delta.
name: 조르즈 알바레스 린틴섬 도착

src: The Portuguese explorer Rafael Perestrello arrived in Guangzhou.
name: 페레스트렐로 광저우 도착

src: The Portuguese ambassadors Fernão Pires de Andrade and Tomé Pires arrived in Guangzhou.

src: April — The Zhengde Emperor died.
name: 정덕제 사망

src: May — The Zhengde Emperor's cousin, the Chenghua Emperor's grandson the Jiajing Emperor, became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 가정제 즉위

name: 포르투갈 사절단 추방

src: An improved sand-driven mechanical clock was invented.
name: 모래식 기계시계 발명

src: Portuguese trade ships first stopped at Shangchuan Island.
name: 상촨섬 포르투갈 무역선 정박

src: The Ming capital Beijing was expanded to the south, increasing its size from 10 to 12 square kilometres (4 to 4+1⁄2 square miles).
name: 베이징성 확장

src: The Luso-Chinese agreement (1554) for Macau is made between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Ming dynasty.
name: 루소-차이니스 협정

src: The Kingdom of Portugal established a permanent settlement in Macau.
name: 마카오 정착지 건설

src: Ming forces led by Qi Jiguang dealt the wokou a defeat at Cengang.
name: 청강 전투

src: February — The Jiajing Emperor's son the Longqing Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 융경제 즉위

src: The Ming haijin (ban on private maritime commerce) was repealed.
name: 해금 폐지

src: July — The Longqing Emperor's son the Wanli Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 만력제 즉위

src: Spain established a permanent base at Manila.
name: 스페인 마닐라 거점 건설

src: The grand secretary Zhang Juzheng instituted the single whip law, under which all monetary and labor obligations to the central government were consolidated into a single silver payment.
name: 일조편법 시행

src: Jesuit China missions: The Jesuit missionary Matteo Ricci arrived in Macau.
name: 마테오 리치 마카오 도착

src: Private newspapers were first published in Beijing.
name: 민간 신문 발행

src: The earliest known depiction of the sailing carriage appeared.
name: 돛 달린 수레 묘사

src: Li Shizhen published the Compendium of Materia Medica.
name: 본초강목 편찬

src: Wu Cheng'en wrote Journey to the West.
name: 서유기 저술

src: Japanese invasions of Korea: Some two hundred thousand Japanese troops invaded Joseon.
name: 임진왜란

src: January — Siege of Pyongyang: A combined Ming-Joseon force drove the Japanese army from Pyongyang.
name: 평양성 전투

src: September — Battle of Sacheon: A Japanese army under siege at Sacheon drove off a numerically superior Ming-Joseon force after the accidental explosion of the Ming powder cache.
name: 사천 전투

src: The Peony Pavilion was first performed at the Pavilion of Prince Teng.
name: 모란정 초연

src: The Dutch East India Company (VOC) began shipping Chinese ceramics to Europe.
name: 중국 도자기 유럽 수출

src: The grand secretary Gu Xiancheng reopened the Donglin Academy in Wuxi, establishing the Donglin movement.
name: 동림당 운동 창설

src: Euclid's Elements was first translated into Chinese.
name: 원론 중국어 초역

src: February — Nurhaci declared himself khan of the later Jin dynasty.
name: 후금 건국

src: All foreign Jesuits were expelled from the Ming imperial court and astronomy bureau.
name: 예수회 선교사 추방

src: April — Battle of Sarhu: The last of four Ming armies was destroyed during a retreat from a punitive expedition against Nurhaci and the later Jin. Its commander Li Rubai committed suicide
name: 사르후 전투

src: August — The Wanli Emperor died.
name: 만력제 사망

src: August — The Wanli Emperor's son the Taichang Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 태창제 즉위

src: September — The Taichang Emperor died.
name: 태창제 사망

src: October — The Taichang Emperor's young son the Tianqi Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 천계제 즉위

src: The VOC established the state of Dutch Formosa.
name: 네덜란드령 포모사 수립

src: Johann Adam Schall von Bell wrote the first Chinese language treatise on the telescope.
name: 망원경 논문 저술

src: The Jesuit Nicolas Trigault invented the first system for the romanization of Chinese.
name: 로마자 표기법 고안

src: January — First Manchu invasion of Korea: Nurhaci's son Hong Taiji, the khan of the later Jin dynasty, invaded Joseon.
name: 정묘호란

src: September — The Tianqi Emperor died.
name: 천계제 사망

src: October — The Tianqi Emperor's younger brother the Chongzhen Emperor became emperor of the Ming dynasty.
name: 숭정제 즉위

src: December — The eunuch Wei Zhongxian committed suicide on hearing that the Jinyiwei had issued a warrant for his arrest.
name: 위충현 자결

src: The Polish Jesuit Michał Boym first introduced the heliocentric model of the Solar System into Chinese astronomy.
name: 태양중심설 도입

src: The later Jin dynasty conquered Inner Mongolia.
name: 내몽골 정복

src: The Chongzhen Emperor acquired the telescope of the late Johann Schreck.
name: 슈렉 망원경 입수

src: Liu Tong wrote a preface to the Dijing Jingwulue.
name: 제경경물략 서문
