name: 영국선 무로란 내항

src: 昌平坂学問所（聖堂）を官学校とする。
name: 쇼헤이자카 학문소 관학화

src: 本居宣長、『古事記伝』を完成させる。最上徳内と近藤重蔵が択捉島探検。
name: 고사기전 완성

src: 十返舎一九、『東海道中膝栗毛』を発表。
name: 동해도중 히자쿠리게 발표

src: ロシア使節ニコライ・レザノフ、長崎に来航し通商を要求。
name: 레자노프 내항

src: 箱館奉行を廃止し、松前奉行を置く。
name: 마쓰마에 부교 설치

src: ロシアの軍艦艦長ヴァシーリー・ゴローニン、国後島で捕らえられる（ゴローニン事件）。
name: 골로브닌 사건

src: 曲亭馬琴、『南総里見八犬伝』を発表。
name: 난소사토미 팔견전 발표

src: 伊能忠敬、『大日本沿海輿地全図』を完成させる。
name: 대일본연해여지전도 완성

src: イギリス人船員が常陸国大津浜に上陸し、水戸藩の尋問を受ける（大津浜事件）。
name: 오쓰하마 사건

src: オランダ商館付のドイツ人医師フィリップ・フランツ・フォン・シーボルトに諜報の嫌疑がかけられ、連座した天文方の高橋景保ら処罰される（シーボルト事件）。
name: 지볼트 사건

src: 葛飾北斎、『富嶽三十六景』を発表。
name: 후가쿠 36경 발표

src: 歌川広重、『東海道五十三次』を発表。
name: 도카이도 53차 발표

src: 水野忠邦、老中となる。
name: 미즈노 다다쿠니 로주 취임

src: アメリカ使節ジェームズ・ビドル、相模国浦賀に来航し通商を要求。
name: 비들 내항

src: アメリカ領事タウンゼント・ハリスが下田に着任。日蘭和親条約調印。
name: 해리스 시모다 부임

src: 横浜に外国人居留地を造成。
name: 요코하마 외국인거류지 조성

src: 江戸開城（江戸城無血開城）
name: 에도성 무혈개성

src: 加波山事件、秩父事件、名古屋事件
name: 가바산 사건

src: 天津条約締結。内閣制度が発足し、太政官制廃止。山手線が開業。
name: 톈진조약 체결

src: ノルマントン号事件、学校令公布。
name: 노르만톤호 사건

src: 市制町村制施行。枢密院設置。
name: 시제정촌제 시행

src: 日英通商航海条約締結（領事裁判権撤廃）、日清戦争。
name: 청일전쟁

src: 貨幣法が公布され、金本位制が確立する。
name: 금본위제 확립

src: 第1次大隈内閣成立（日本初の政党内閣）。
name: 제1차 오쿠마 내각 성립

src: 著作権保護等を定めたベルヌ条約に加盟。
name: 베른조약 가맹

src: 立憲政友会結成。軍部大臣現役武官制導入。
name: 입헌정우회 결성

src: 明治天皇崩御、大正に改元。近代オリンピックに日本が初参加（1912年ストックホルムオリンピック）。
name: 메이지 천황 붕어

src: 沖縄県庁放火事件。第一次護憲運動（大正政変）。
name: 오키나와현청 방화사건

src: 対華21カ条要求。第一回全国高等学校野球選手権大会開催。
name: 21개조 요구

src: 大正天皇崩御、昭和に改元。
name: 다이쇼 천황 붕어

src: 天皇機関説問題、相沢事件。
name: 천황기관설 문제

src: 月 同盟国イタリアが連合国に降伏。
name: 이탈리아 항복

src: 月 米軍が慶良間諸島に上陸し、沖縄戦開始。
name: 오키나와 전투 개시

src: 月 米軍が沖縄本島に上陸
name: 오키나와 상륙

src: 月 同盟国ドイツが連合国に降伏。
name: 독일 항복

src: 月9日 長崎市への原子爆弾投下。
name: 나가사키 원폭 투하

src: 月3日 ソビエト連邦が北方領土占領。
name: 북방영토 점령

src: 月 財閥解体指令。日本社会党結成。
name: 재벌 해체

src: 月 選挙法改正により女性参政権が確立。日本共産党の合法化。
name: 여성참정권 확립

src: ロシアのウクライナ侵攻による経済的影響
name: 우크라이나 침공

src: The mass migration of groups from the Asian continent to the Japanese archipelago marked the transition to the Yayoi period. Japanese society transitioned to a settled agricultural economy. Yayoi immigrants were integrated with the indigenous population, resulting in a synthesis of new cultural influences and existing practices.
name: 야요이 시대 시작

src: Emperor Guangwu of Han issued the King of Na gold seal to the coalition of Japanese states in northern Kyushu led by the state of Nakoku.
name: 한위노국왕 금인 하사

src: The Nagata Shrine, Hirota Shrine and Ikuta Shrine, the oldest surviving Shinto shrines in Japan, are founded by the legendary Empress Jingū.
name: 신사 세 곳 창건

src: Himiko sends the first emissaries from Japan to China.
name: 히미코 사신 파견

src: Himiko dies and is succeeded by 13 year old Queen Toyo after a brief civil war. Some rebels, preferring a male successor, fled Yamatai and founded the Miwa court in Nara.
name: 도요 여왕 즉위

src: The Kofun period and Yamato period starts, which marks the founding of Yamato entity in Nara associated with the Sujin line of emperors.
name: 고훈 시대 시작

src: Toyo sends an embassy to Emperor Wu of Jin.
name: 도요 사절 파견

src: The Hata clan, led by Yuzuki no Kimi, settles in Japan, introducing sericulture (silk farming).
name: 하타씨 정착

src: The Makimuku site is abandoned, possibly due to invaders such as Baekje and Gaya confederacy men, indicating large changes of the Miwa court.
name: 마키무쿠 유적 폐기

src: Emperor Chūai of Miwa court is replaced by Emperor Ōjin of Kawachi court (Saki Court), marking the expansion of Yamato Province to the Kinai region.
name: 오진 천황 즉위

src: Goguryeo–Wa conflicts between Wa, Baekje, and Gaya against Goguryeo and Silla
name: 고구려-왜 전쟁

src: King of Wa sends first recorded tribute to the Jin.
name: 왜왕 조공

src: Yamato polity become a regional power after subjugating several states in West Japan.
name: 야마토 정권 통합

src: Chronology of the Japanese historical records becomes consistent. All earlier dated entries are reconstructed from foreign or archaeological sources.
Baekje sends an embassy to Japan, as confirmed by both Japanese and Korean records.
name: 백제 사절 파견

src: Iron tools become widespread in archeological record, marking the advent of Iron Age in Japan.
name: 철기 시대 도래

src: Kawachi court is succeeded by King Ohoto of Koshi (Keitai line of kings) in Asuka court.
name: 게이타이 왕 즉위

src: Seong of Baekje introduces Buddhism to Japan.
name: 불교 공전

src: The Asuka period starts, and the Imperial capital is transferred to Asuka. Yamato polity achieve de facto political dominance with full conquest of Shikoku and Kyushu islands.
name: 아스카 시대 시작

src: The last states of Gaya confederacy are destroyed, marking extinction of Japonic languages outside Japan.
name: 가야 멸망

src: The Soga clan takes control of Japan with the installation of Empress Suiko on the throne.
name: 소가씨 집권

src: The Asuka period ends with the power of the Soga clan broken in the Isshi incident and Nakatomi clan becoming the dominant power.
name: 잇시의 변

src: January — The Hakuhō period starts with the Taika Reform.
name: 다이카 개신

src: Japanese, under command of Abe no Hirafu, massacre the Mishihase people in Hokkaido. The Japanese do not return to Hokkaido until over 700 years later.
name: 미시하세 학살

src: Japanese enter the Baekje–Tang War.
name: 백제·당 전쟁 참전

src: First coastal defences of Kyushu were built at what is now the Ōnojō Castle Ruins.
name: 오노조 성 축조

src: With the reign of Emperor Tenmu, Japan becomes an empire.
name: 덴무 천황 즉위

src: Hakuho earthquake, severe tsunami and subsidence at Tosa Province.
name: 하쿠호 지진

src: The Fort Ideha is established near modern Akita, marking the start of submission of the Emishi people in the Tōhoku region to Japanese.
name: 이데하 성 설치

src: The Nara period starts after Empress Genmei establishes the capital of Heijō-kyō.
name: 나라 시대 시작

src: The law prohibiting nobles from restricting peasant's access to non-agricultural areas is enacted. Stagnation in cultivated land area begins and continues until the 14th century.
name: 농민 출입 제한 금지

src: The provinces are ordered to compile cultural and geographical records, known as fudoki.
name: 후도키 편찬 명령

src: Fujiwara no Fuhito compiles the Yōrō Code (the update of Taihō Code) which is accepted in 757.
name: 요로율령 편찬

src: November — Murder of governor Kamitsukenu no Ason Hirohito and subsequent punitive expedition to Mutsu Province.
name: 국사 히로히토 피살

src: The Hayato rebellion ends after a year and half of fighting, marking the complete subjugation of Southern Kyushu.
name: 하야토의 난 종결

src: Severe drought occurs and the government attempts to mitigate it by clearing farmland in the Mutsu Province.
name: 가뭄 발생

src: Emperor Shōmu was enthroned. Also, the site of the Taga Castle, near to modern Sendai, is founded.
name: 쇼무 천황 즉위

src: April — A fleet of 300 Japanese vessels is defeated on the east coast on Silla.
name: 일본 함대 신라 패전

src: Genbō and Kibi no Makibi return from China.
name: 겐보·마키비 귀국

src: A major smallpox epidemic spreads from Kyushu, resulting in a third of the population perishing, 10 years of social instability and 4 transfers of the Imperial capital through Kuni-kyō, Shigaraki Palace and Naniwa-kyō before returning to Heijō-kyō in 745.
name: 덴표 천연두 대유행

src: Shōmu establishes the provincial temples as a part of shift from Confucianism to Buddhism, impacted by ongoing epidemic and famine.
name: 국분사 건립

src: The Ritsuryō law system incorporates the right of eternal land ownership by any squatter in an attempt to mitigate rampant vagrancy.
name: 간전영년사재법

src: Establishment of the centralized rice tax system.
name: 중앙 조세제도 확립

src: End of first smallpox epidemic.
name: 천연두 유행 종식

src: The Kaifūsō poetry anthology is completed.
name: 가이후소 완성

src: Priest Ganjin arrives from China.
name: 감진 도래

src: Fujiwara no Nakamaro defeats an attempt by Tachibana no Naramaro to seize power.
name: 나라마로의 난

src: Severe epidemic of unidentified illness begins to spread from the Iki Island.
name: 이키섬 역병 발생

src: Fujiwara no Nakamaro and Emperor Junnin launches a failed plot against the retired Empress Kōken and the monk Dōkyō.
name: 나카마로의 난

src: The Thirty-Eight Years War for the subjugation of Tōhoku begins.
Relatively minor smallpox outbreak resulting in large mortality of men aged 30 or below.
name: 천연두 유행

src: The first shōgun, Ōtomo no Otomaro, is appointed by Emperor Kanmu in 794 CE. A shōgun was the military dictator of Japan with near absolute power over territories via the military.
name: 첫 쇼군 임명

src: The Heian period starts after Emperor Kanmu moves the capital to Heian-kyō (ancient name of Kyoto). Emperor Kanmu chooses to relocate the capital in order to distance it from the clerical establishment in Nara.
name: 헤이안 시대 시작

src: The Shoku Nihongi (2nd volume of historical chronicles Rikkokushi) was completed.
name: 속일본기 완성

src: After the defeat of the Emishi Isawa confederation and execution of Aterui in the final stages of Thirty-Eight Years War [ja], the Japanese control the entire Honshu island.
name: 혼슈 전역 장악

src: The Japanese kana scripts (invention popularly attributed to Kūkai) have evolved as distinct from Chinese characters.
name: 가나 문자 성립

src: Emperor Saga ascends to the throne, resulting in a 32-year long relatively peaceful period.
name: 사가 천황 즉위

src: The Kusuko incident, abortive attempt by retired Emperor Heisei to seize power and return the capital to Heijō-kyō.
name: 구스코의 변

src: Second major outbreak of smallpox epidemic killing "nearly half" of the Japanese population.
name: 천연두 대유행

src: Emperor Saga's 7th son is demoted to commoner status under the name Minamoto no Makoto, starting the Minamoto clan.
name: 미나모토 씨 성립

src: Shinsen Shōjiroku, the first compilation of Japanese genealogical data, is completed.
name: 신찬성씨록 완성

src: The Kōnin Code, a land reform promoting land reclamation and large-scale landed estates, is issued.
name: 고닌 율령 반포

src: January — Kūkai establishes the first public school in Japan.
name: 구카이 공립학교 설립

src: Last envoy to Tang China sent (some later embassies were cancelled).
name: 마지막 견당사 파견

src: Nihon Kōki (3rd volume of historical chronicles Rikkokushi) was completed.
name: 일본후기 완성

src: The Jōwa incident marks the rising power of the Fujiwara clan.
name: 조와의 변

src: February — Minor outbreak of smallpox. Outbreaks continue with average interval of 30 years until smallpox becomes endemic by 1061.
name: 천연두 유행

src: Large-scale insurrection by the Emishi people of northern Japan.
name: 에조 반란

src: Large-scale insurrection by Tsushima Province.
name: 쓰시마 반란

src: The Fujiwara clan solidify their rule over Japan with the installation of Emperor Seiwa; Fujiwara no Yoshifusa becomes Sesshō.
name: 세이와 천황 즉위

src: Construction begins on Iwashimizu Hachiman-gū.
name: 이와시미즈하치만구 건설

src: Shoku Nihon Kōki (4th volume of historical chronicles Rikkokushi) was completed.
name: 속일본후기 완성

src: July — Devastating 869 Sanriku earthquake and tsunami occur off the Tohoku coast.
name: 산리쿠 지진

src: March — Akita Castle is overrun during the Gangyou disturbance [ja] with the background of heavy drought and famine, resulting in growing independence of Dewa Province.
name: 간교의 난

src: Nihon Montoku Tennō Jitsuroku (5th volume of historical chronicles Rikkokushi) was completed.
name: 일본문덕천황실록 완성

src: Emperor Yōzei is deposed; he is replaced by Emperor Kōkō.
name: 요제이 천황 폐위

src: Emperor Uda ascends to the throne; Ako Controversy around edict issued naming Fujiwara no Mototsune as Kanpaku.
name: 아코 사건

src: Sugawara no Michizane advocates for ending Japanese embassies to China.
name: 견당사 폐지 주장

src: Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku (6th and last of historical chronicles Rikkokushi) was completed.
name: 일본삼대실록 완성

src: Severe epidemics and extreme weather including floods and drought, popularly attributed to persecution of Sugawara no Michizane
The Tosa Nikki, the oldest surviving Japanese diary, is written.
name: 도사 닛키 저술

src: Tengyō no Ran – the failed rebellion of Taira no Masakado in Hitachi Province and Shimōsa Province, Fujiwara no Sumitomo in Iyo Province and San'yō region, plus opportunistic uprisings in Dewa Province – the first of many rebellions led by professional warriors (samurai), has led to the downfall of the Tachibana clan.
name: 덴교의 난

src: The 56 warrior monks of Tōdai-ji stage the public protest, marking the formation of sōhei class and militarization of temples.
name: 도다이지 승병 항의

src: The Ishinpō, the oldest surviving Japanese medical manual, is compiled.
name: 이신포 편찬

src: An unprecedented scale epidemic ravages Heian-kyō, killing many nobles on the background of sectarian strife.
name: 헤이안쿄 전염병

src: Murasaki Shikibu writes The Tale of Genji.
name: 겐지 이야기 저술

src: Taira no Tadatsune starts a three-years-long war in present-day Chiba Prefecture before surrendering.
name: 다이라노 다다쓰네 반란

src: The Ritsuryō system has completely failed due to encroachment by private manors. Emperor Go-Sanjō land reform attempt was thwarted by Fujiwara no Yorimichi, signaling the terminal decline of imperial power.
Severe drought created the Yōwa famine.
name: 요와 대기근

src: The Kamakura period starts after the Genpei War ends with the defeat of the Taira clan, resulting in establishment of the Kamakura shogunate.
name: 가마쿠라 시대 시작

src: June — The Battle of Koromo River have ended de facto independence of the Northern Fujiwara clan in Tōhoku. As result, first Japanese refugees have settled in Kaminokuni, Hokkaido.
name: 고로모강 전투

src: Kamakura became the de facto capital of Japan in about 1180 AD, following the victories of the Minamoto over the Taira. It officially became the capital in 1192 when Minamoto Yoritomo was declared shōgun.
name: 가마쿠라 막부 성립

src: Minamoto no Yoritomo seized power from the central government and the aristocracy and established a feudal system based in Kamakura. The samurai gained political power over the aristocratic nobility (kuge) of the Imperial Court in Kyoto. Minamoto no Yoritomo was awarded the title of Sei-i Taishōgun by Emperor Go-Toba. The Emperor became a figurehead. The political system that Yoritomo developed with a succession of shōguns as the head became known as a shogunate. The military class would rule Japan near continuously from 1192 till 1868 CE.
name: 세이이타이쇼군 임명

src: The Goseibai Shikimoku code accepted and used until the Edo period, marking militarization of legal system
name: 고세이바이시키모쿠 제정

src: st Mongol invasion in Japan repulsed in the Battle of Bun'ei
name: 분에이 전투

src: nd Mongol invasion in Japan repulsed in the Battle of Kōan
name: 고안 전투

src: July — The short-lived Kenmu Restoration starts with the destruction of the Kamakura shogunate in the siege of Kamakura (1333).
name: 겐무 신정

src: Imperial court of Japan splits in two until 1392, resulting in the Nanboku-chō period.
name: 남북조 시대 시작

src: The Muromachi period starts with the establishment of the Ashikaga shogunate domination over the imperial Northern Court. The Daimyō system is established.
name: 무로마치 시대 시작

src: The Jinnō Shōtōki is written, formalizing Emperor's of Japan role transition from ruler to the mystical symbol.
name: 신황정통기 저술

src: February — The Southern Court loses the Battle of Shijōnawate.
name: 시조나와테 전투

src: Kannō disturbance weakens the Ashikaga shogunate. Wokou pirates from Japan are becoming rampant in region.
name: 간노의 소란

src: The Southern Court wins the Battle of Yawata, enabling the siege of Kyoto in 1354.
name: 야와타 전투

src: The Nanboku-chō period ends with the subjugation of the Southern Court to the Northern Court.
name: 남북조 시대 종결

src: Cholera epidemic and extreme impoverishment in now Shiga Prefecture have resulted in the Shocho uprising.
name: 쇼초 봉기

src: Flare-up of Eikyō disturbance [ja] in the Kantō region after 22 years of confrontation between local lords and shogunate
name: 에이쿄의 난

src: The Treaty of Gyehae was signed, resulting in Wokou pirates becoming increasingly non-Japanese.
name: 계해약조 체결

src: The Kyōtoku incident starts the 32 years of instability and bloodshed in the semi-independent Kantō region.
name: 교토쿠의 난

src: Takeda Nobuhiro emerged victorious after repelling an Ainu assault on Kaminokuni, Hokkaido, marking the beginning of Japanese conquest of Hokkaido.
name: 홋카이도 정복 개시

src: Bad handling of the Kanshō famine in the aftermath of flood and plague in Kyoto has resulted in increasing divisions of society.
name: 간쇼 대기근

src: Kyoto has been completely destroyed. Iga Province by this point has successfully rejected the authority of the local shugo.
name: 교토 완전 파괴

src: The Yamashiro uprising establishes the Yamashiro ikki,
name: 야마시로 봉기

src: Battle of Magari: Rokkaku Takayori, supported by ninja from Iga ikki and Kōka ikki, defeats an expedition from Shogun Ashikaga Yoshihisa.
name: 마가리 전투

src: The Kaga Rebellion overthrows Togashi Masachika and establishes a theocratic confederation, the Kaga ikki, in now-Ishikawa Prefecture.
name: 가가의 난

src: The Ashikaga shogunate destroys the Yamashiro ikki.
name: 야마시로 잇키 멸망

src: September — 1498 Nankai earthquake
name: 난카이 대지진

src: Japanese in-fighting results in the Ningbo incident, bringing trade with China to a halt and resulting in a new wave of Wokou piracy.
name: 영파쟁공

src: August — The first Europeans, the Portuguese, arrive at Japan, opening the Nanban trade period.
name: 난반 무역 개시

src: Oda Nobunaga starts a 10-year long Ishiyama Hongan-ji War to suppress the warrior monk community and the Kaga ikki state.
name: 이시야마 혼간지 전쟁

src: Japanese society begins to stabilize, starting the Azuchi–Momoyama period under the rule of Oda Nobunaga and later Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
name: 아즈치모모야마 시대

src: The Rokkaku clan and Kōka ikki surrender to Nobunaga. The Iga–Kōka alliance is thus terminated.
name: 롯카쿠·고카 항복

src: Azuchi religious debate results in enforced religious tolerance.
name: 아즈치 종론

src: Oda Nobunaga forces win the Tenshō Iga War, destroying the Iga ikki.
name: 덴쇼 이가의 난

src: Himeji Castle, the largest in Japan, was built.
name: 히메지성 축조

src: Honnō-ji incident: Akechi Mitsuhide betrays Oda Nobunaga who commits suicide
name: 혼노지의 변

src: Toyotomi Hideyoshi launches the Kyūshū campaign.
name: 규슈 정벌

src: August — Toyotomi Hideyoshi prevails over the Late Hōjō clan in the siege of Odawara in the Kantō region, completing the re-unification of Japan.
name: 오다와라 전투

src: May — Toyotomi Hideyoshi, acting as kampaku (regent) in lieu of Oda Nobukatsu, invaded Korea.
name: 임진왜란

src: February — 26 Martyrs of Japan were crucified in Nagasaki in the aftermath of the San Felipe incident.
name: 일본 26성인 순교

src: March — The Edo period starts after Tokugawa Ieyasu received from Emperor Go-Yōzei the title of shōgun.
name: 에도 시대 시작

src: The town of Edo became the de facto capital of Japan and center of political power. This was after Tokugawa Ieyasu established the bakufu headquarters in Edo. Kyoto remained the formal capital of the country.
name: 에도 막부 개설

src: February — 1605 Nankai earthquake and tsunami
name: 게이초 지진

src: Ieyasu abdicated from office in favor of his third son and heir, Tokugawa Hidetada.
name: 히데타다 쇼군 취임

src: June — The siege of Osaka is complete with the Battle of Tennōji: Tokugawa Ieyasu ended Toyotomi opposition.
name: 오사카 전투

src: Hidetada resigned his office to his eldest son and heir, Tokugawa Iemitsu.
name: 이에미쓰 쇼군 취임

src: The Sakoku Edict of 1635 was issued by the Tokugawa shogunate. This isolationist foreign policy barred Japanese from leaving Japan and barred Europeans from entering, on pain of death. It instituted strict penalties for the practice of Catholicism and severely restricted foreign trade.
name: 쇄국령 반포

src: The policy of sankin-kōtai was established, which subjected the daimyōs to the will of the shōgun.
name: 산킨코타이 제도

src: April — Shimabara Rebellion: The last of the rebels were defeated in their fortress at Shimabara.
name: 시마바라의 난

src: April — Iemitsu died, leaving his office to the ten-year-old Tokugawa Ietsuna.
name: 이에쓰나 쇼군 취임

src: Keian Uprising: A coup d'état attempted by several rōnin and masterminded by Yui Shōsetsu and Marubashi Chūya failed.
name: 게이안의 변

src: June — Ietsuna died and was succeeded by his younger brother, Tokugawa Tsunayoshi.
name: 쓰나요시 쇼군 취임

src: March — Chūshingura – Forty-seven rōnin were ordered to commit seppuku by the shōgun.
name: 주신구라

src: February — Tsunayoshi died. His nephew Tokugawa Ienobu succeeded him as shōgun.
name: 이에노부 쇼군 취임

src: The Wakan Sansai Zue, the first Japanese encyclopaedia, was published.
name: 화한삼재도회 출판

src: November — Ienobu died and was succeeded by his five-year-old son, Tokugawa Ietsugu, under the regency of the shōgun's adviser Arai Hakuseki.
name: 이에쓰구 쇼군 취임

src: June — Ietsugu died. Tokugawa Yoshimune, a great-grandson of Tokugawa Ieyasu, became shōgun.
name: 요시무네 쇼군 취임

src: The foreign books restrictions are reduced, starting a Rangaku practice.
name: 난학 시작

src: Yoshimune retired, leaving his public office to his eldest son Tokugawa Ieshige, although he maintained some influence in the affairs of state.
name: 이에시게 쇼군 취임

src: Ieshige retired, leaving his office to his eldest son Tokugawa Ieharu.
name: 이에하루 쇼군 취임

src: January — Empress Go-Sakuramachi abdicated in favor of her nephew Go-Momozono. She was the last empress regnant of Japan up until now.
name: 고사쿠라마치 천황 양위

src: August — Tenmei eruption of Mount Asama
name: 덴메이 대분화

src: May — 1792 Unzen earthquake and tsunami
name: 운젠 지진과 쓰나미

src: Khvostov raids on the Japanese-controlled Kuril Islands.
name: 흐보스토프 습격

src: Failed military expedition to Sakhalin
name: 사할린 원정 실패

src: The Golovnin Incident marks increasing contacts with the Russian Empire.
name: 골로브닌 사건

src: March — Emperor Ninkō died at the age of 45 and was succeeded by Emperor Kōmei.
name: 고메이 천황 즉위

src: July — The isolation policy of the Tokugawa shogunate has begun to crumble by the time of landing of Ranald MacDonald on Rishiri Island.
name: 로널드 맥도널드 상륙

src: July — Matthew C. Perry arrives off the coast of Japan in four ships. Perry orders harbor buildings to be shelled to force negotiations for a letter President Millard Fillmore sent to the ruler of Japan. This incident was coined as the "Arrival of the Black Ships" in Japanese history.
name: 흑선 내항

src: February — Matthew C. Perry returns to Japan with eight Black Ships and finds that the shogunate had prepared a treaty accepting virtually all demands from President Millard Fillmore.
name: 페리 재내항

src: August — With the arrival of the modern Dutch paddle steamer Kankō Maru, the Tokugawa shogunate establishes the Nagasaki Naval Training Center as part of its modernization efforts to meet the perceived military threat posed by the western nations and learn Western-style science and naval theory. The cadets who attended the center such as Enomoto Takeaki and Katsu Kaishū would go on to found the Imperial Japanese Navy following the Meiji Restoration in 1868.
name: 나가사키 해군 전습소 설립

src: August — The Anglo-Japanese Treaty of Amity and Commerce and other Ansei Treaties were signed, resulting in Ansei Purge.
name: 안세이 대옥

src: February — Ambassador Shinmi Masaoki sets sail for San Francisco, leading the first Japanese diplomatic mission to the United States.
name: 만엔 원년 견미사절

src: March — The Japanese ship Kanrin Maru arrives in San Francisco with the delegation, marking the first official visit to a foreign state following the end of its 214-year isolationist policy, demonstrating the degree to which Japan had mastered Western navigation techniques and ship technologies in the 6 years since opening its borders.
name: 간린마루 도착

src: July — Battle of Shimonoseki Straits
name: 시모노세키 해협 전투

src: September — Tenchūgumi incident - the year-long rebellion in Yamato Province starts.
name: 덴추구미의 변

src: May — The Mito Rebellion starts in Mito Domain and continues until January 1865.
name: 미토 반란

src: August — Kinmon incident - an attempt to kidnap an Emperor Kōmei, resulting in partial burning of Kyoto. It was retaliated by the abortive First Chōshū expedition.
name: 금문의 변

src: June — The Second Chōshū expedition starts, only to be halted after death of shogun Tokugawa Iemochi in August 1866, critically discrediting the Tokugawa shogunate.
name: 제2차 조슈 정벌

src: January — Emperor Kōmei died at the age of 35. It's generally believed due to the smallpox epidemic. This marked the end of the Edo period.
name: 고메이 천황 사망

src: February — Emperor Meiji ascended the Chrysanthemum Throne. This marked the start of the Meiji Period.
name: 메이지 천황 즉위

src: January — Meiji Restoration restored practical abilities and the political system under Emperor Meiji. This ended the Tokugawa Shogunate.
name: 메이지 유신

src: The city of Edo was formally renamed to Tokyo ("eastern capital"). The city of Tokyo was officially established.
name: 에도 도쿄 개칭

src: May — Emperor Meiji moved his residence from Kyoto to Tokyo. Edo castle became the Imperial Palace. This made Tokyo the formal capital of Japan.
name: 도쿄 천도

src: Abolition of Han system, being replaced by a system of Japanese prefectures.
name: 폐번치현

src: Seikanron: Japanese government debated and rejected the idea of the invasion of Korea.
name: 정한론

src: Land Tax Reform (Japan 1873)
name: 지조개정

src: February to 9 April — Saga Rebellion
name: 사가의 난

src: May to 3 December — Mudan incident in Greater China.
name: 모란사 사건

src: Japan quickly transformed in one generation from an isolated feudal society to a modern industrialized nation state and an emerging great power.
Akizuki, Hagi and Shinpūren Rebellions.
name: 아키즈키의 난

src: November — The Constitution of the Empire of Japan (Meiji Constitution) was enacted. This turned Japan into a quasi-absolute monarchy with a representative democracy.
name: 메이지 헌법 제정

src: October — 1891 Mino–Owari earthquake: A strongest recorded inland earthquake of Japan.
name: 노비 지진

src: August — First Sino-Japanese War starts.
name: 청일 전쟁

src: April — The First Sino-Japanese War is won by the Japanese, resulting in the Treaty of Shimonoseki. It was the first major conflict between Japan and an overseas military power in modern times. For the first time, regional dominance in East Asia shifted from China to Japan. Korea became a vassal state of Japan.
name: 시모노세키 조약

src: May — Japanese invasion of Taiwan (1895)
name: 타이완 침공

src: June — Sanriku earthquake kills 22,066 people.
name: 산리쿠 지진

src: January — Russo-Japanese War: Japan became the first Asian nation to sign a mutual defense pact with a European nation, Britain.
name: 영일동맹

src: February — Russo-Japanese War: Japan launched a surprise torpedo attack on the Imperial Russian Navy at Port Arthur.
name: 뤼순항 기습공격

src: September — Russo-Japanese War: Japan became the first modern Asian nation to win a war against an Eastern European nation (Russia). The Treaty of Portsmouth was signed, ceding some Russian property and territory to Japan and ending the war. Pro-war activists staged the Hibiya incendiary incident nevertheless. This changed the global world order. Japan became the main Asian power.
name: 포츠머스 조약

src: August — Japan–Korea Treaty completes the annexation of the Korean Empire.
name: 한일 병합

src: December — Japanese Antarctic Expedition starts.
name: 일본 남극 탐험

src: July — Emperor Meiji died of kidney failure and ulcerative colitis at the age of 59.
name: 메이지 천황 사망

src: July — Prince Taisho becomes as the Emperor of Japan, marking the start of the Taishō period.
name: 다이쇼 시대 개막

src: to 6 September — Japanese seaplane carrier Wakamiya conducts the world's first successful naval-launched air raids on 5 September 1914 and during the first months of World War I from Jiaozhou Bay off Qingdao. The first air-sea battle in history took place on 6 September 1914.
name: 와카미야 함재기 공습

src: October — The siege of Qingdao starts as part of World War I.
name: 칭다오 공방전

src: January — Japan sends the Twenty-One Demands to China.
name: 21개조 요구

src: Kogyo Shoyuken Senji Ho, the Wartime Law on Industrial Property, is enacted.
name: 전시 공업소유권 특례법

src: January 1918 to April 1920 — Spanish flu pandemic began to devastate Japan, which killed 400,000 people.
name: 스페인 독감 유행

src: April — Japanese intervention in Siberia starts and continues until 1922.
name: 시베리아 출병

src: July to September — Rice riots of 1918
name: 쌀 소동

src: July — Siberian intervention is launched.
name: 시베리아 출병

src: March — March 1st Movement begins to invigorate the Korean independence movement.
name: 3·1 운동

src: Japan helps found the League of Nations.
name: 국제연맹 창설

src: November — Hōshō, the first Japanese aircraft carrier, is launched.
name: 호쇼 진수

src: November — Crown Prince Hirohito becomes regent because his father, Emperor Taisho, contracts a serious illness.
name: 히로히토 섭정

src: December — Four-Power Treaty is signed with America, Britain, and France.
name: 4개국 조약

src: February — Five Power Naval Disarmament Treaty is signed.
name: 워싱턴 해군 군축조약

src: August — Japan withdraws troops from Siberia.
name: 시베리아 철수

src: September — Great Kanto earthquake kills 140,000 people.
name: 관동 대지진

src: January — Crown Prince Hirohito (Future Emperor Shōwa) marries Princess Nagako of Kuni (Future Empress Nagako).
name: 히로히토-나가코 결혼

src: May — General Election Law is passed and all men above age 25 gain the right to vote.
name: 일반선거법 제정

src: December — Emperor Taishō dies of a heart attack at the age of 47 after developing pneumonia.
name: 다이쇼 천황 사망

src: December — Prince Hirohito becomes the Emperor of Japan after the death of his father Yoshihito. This marks the start of Shōwa period, and the last period of the Empire of Japan (during the final year of World War II).
name: 쇼와 시대 개막

src: January to April — Shōwa financial crisis begins.
name: 쇼와 금융공황

src: December — Tokyo Metro Ginza Line between Ueno and Asakusa is built.
name: 도쿄 지하철 긴자선 개통

src: to 11 May — Jinan incident.
name: 지난 사건

src: October — Wushe incident, a rebellion on Taiwan, which was the last major uprising against colonial Japanese forces in Taiwan.
name: 무샤 사건

src: September — Japan invaded Manchuria in the aftermath of Mukden incident in Northeastern China.
name: 만주사변

src: March — Manchukuo, a puppet state of Japan, is established.
name: 만주국 수립

src: January to 3 March — Shanghai incident begins and lasts only two months.
name: 상하이 사변

src: May — Prime Minister Inukai Tsuyoshi is assassinated during the Japanese coup d'état.
name: 5·15 사건

src: to 28 February — Prime Minister Keisuke Okada survives the February 26 incident. However, he left office one month later.
name: 2·26 사건

src: July — Second Sino-Japanese War begins.
name: 중일전쟁

src: September to 8 October — Battle of Changsha begins in Hunan Province, China.
name: 창사 전투

src: March to 3 April — Battle of Wuyuan begins.
name: 우위안 전투

src: May to 18 June — Battle of Zaoyang-Yichang begins.
name: 조양·의창 전투

src: April — Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact is signed.
name: 소일 중립조약

src: December — The Empire of Japan attacks the naval base in Pearl Harbor, Hawaii. Japan declares war on the United States, the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the United Kingdom, marking the start of the Pacific War theatre of World War II.
name: 진주만 공격

src: to 10 December — First Battle of Guam begins.
name: 제1차 괌 전투

src: January — Japan declares war on the Netherlands.
name: 대네덜란드 선전포고

src: January — Hideki Tōjō warns Australia with the statement: "If you continue resistance, Japanese will destroy you."
name: 호주 위협 발언

src: February — Japan demands the surrender of Singapore.
name: 싱가포르 항복 요구

src: March — The naval minister Admiral Shigetarō Shimada says that in view of the Allies' "retaliation and hatred", Japan would no longer follow recognized rules of sea warfare.
name: 해전 규칙 준수 포기

src: January to 8 February — Operation Ke, a Japanese naval operation which was intended as the reconnaissance of Pearl Harbor and disruption of repair and salvage operations, takes place following the surprise attack at two years ago.
name: 케 작전

src: January to 4 February — Battle of Wau begins in the eastern parts of New Guinea.
name: 와우 전투

src: June to 9 July — Battle of Saipan begins in the Mariana Islands.
name: 사이판 전투

src: to 16 June — Bombing of Yawata begins in Kyoto Prefecture.
name: 야하타 폭격

src: July to 10 August — Second Battle of Guam begins.
name: 제2차 괌 전투

src: to 20 October — Formosa Air Battle begins.
name: 포르모사 공중전

src: to 31 December — Battle of Pearl Ridge begins.
name: 펄 리지 전투

src: February — U.S. Marines land on Iwo Jima.
name: 이오지마 상륙

src: March and 24 May — Two Bombings of Tokyo begins.
name: 도쿄 대공습

src: March — American Armed Forces win the Battle of Iwo Jima, defeating the last remaining troops led by Tadamichi Kuribayashi.
name: 이오지마 전투 승리

src: and 9 August — Atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in Japan during the final period of World War II.
name: 히로시마·나가사키 원폭

src: August — Soviet invasion of Manchuria starts and continues on as the Kuril Islands dispute.
name: 만주 전략공세작전

src: Japanese economic miracle begins.
name: 일본 경제 기적

src: January — During the New Year's Day, Emperor Shōwa renounces his divinity, known in Japanese as the Human Declaration.
name: 인간선언

src: January — Just five months after his arrival in Japan, the Supreme Commander of the Allied Powers, General Douglas MacArthur orders the Japanese government to expel all militarists from positions of power. The disbandment of all ultra-nationalist organizations is also demanded.
name: 군국주의자 공직 추방

src: March — Kose Cosmetics is founded in Oji region, Tokyo, as predecessor name was Kobayashi Kose Cosmetics.
name: 고세화장품 설립

src: April — Sazae-san is first published.
name: 사자에상 연재 시작

src: May — In the controversial International Military Tribunal for the Far East, the prosecution began of Japanese military leaders for war crimes.
name: 극동국제군사재판

src: May — Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo, the predecessor of Sony, is founded.
name: 도쿄통신공업 설립

src: May — Shigeru Yoshida receives Imperial Order to form a cabinet.
name: 요시다 조각 대명

src: May — Yoshida's cabinet is announced.
name: 요시다 내각 발표

src: June — Emperor Hirohito submits a revision of the Imperial Constitution to the National Diet.
name: 제국헌법 개정안 제출

src: August — Keidanren is established.
name: 게이단렌 설립

src: March — Sekisui Chemical is founded.
name: 세키스이화학 설립

src: August — Supreme Court of Japan is established.
name: 최고재판소 설립

src: September — American occupation of Japan ended after the signing of the Treaty of San Francisco and Security Treaty between United States of America and the State of Japan, which became effective on 28 April 1952. It restored the sovereignty of Japan and established America-Japan alliance.
name: 샌프란시스코 강화조약

src: July — Formation of Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (GSDF), Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF), and Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF).
name: 자위대 창설

src: November — The right-wing and nationalist Liberal Democratic Party, which has ruled Japan almost continuously ever since its foundation, is formed.
name: 자유민주당 결성

src: December — Japan joins the United Nations.
name: 국제연합 가입

src: June — The massive Anpo protests against revision of the America–Japan Security Treaty are the largest protests in Japan's modern history, and force the resignation of Prime Minister Nobusuke Kishi and the cancellation of a planned visit by US president Dwight D. Eisenhower.
name: 안보투쟁

src: October — A largest Japanese land reclamation project thus far was completed in Lake Hachirōgata, creating the village of Ōgata out of 195 km of lakebed reclaimed since 1957.
name: 하치로가타 간척사업

src: October — The first Shinkansen high-speed train railway line was opened.
name: 신칸센 개통

src: Japan surpasses West Germany as the second-largest economic power in the world.
name: 세계 2위 경제대국 등극

src: The Ogasawara Islands are returned from American occupation to Japanese sovereignty. Japanese citizens are allowed to return.
name: 오가사와라 제도 반환

src: January — Japanese student protests against the Vietnam War and American use of bases on Japanese soil culminate in a short-lived takeover of University of Tokyo.
name: 도쿄대학교 점거

src: February — The first successful launch of the Lambda 4S rocket places the Japanese Ohsumi satellite in orbit.
name: 오스미 위성 발사

src: By the 1970s Japan ascended to great power status once more. Japan sees record high economic growth during the Japanese economic miracle.
name: 일본 경제 기적

src: September — Zengakuren demonstrate and riot in Tokyo against terms for the return of Okinawa from US to Japanese control. They wanted to remove all American military presence.
name: 오키나와 반환 반대 시위

src: November — The 1971 Okinawa Reversion Agreement is ratified and returns the Okinawa Prefecture to Japanese sovereignty.
name: 오키나와 반환 협정 비준

src: Prime Minister Eisaku Satō accepts the Nobel Peace Prize.
name: 사토 에이사쿠 노벨평화상 수상

src: Japan became the biggest motor vehicle producing country in the world with 11,042,884 motor vehicles compared to the USA's 8,009,841.
name: 세계 최대 자동차 생산국 등극

src: The domestic North American video game market crashes, allowing Japanese industry to take America's place as the world's largest video game market.
August — Japan Air Lines Flight 123 crashes near Mount Takamagahara, killing 520 people in Japan's worst ever air disaster.
name: 일본항공 123편 추락

src: January — Emperor Hirohito dies of cancer at the age of 87.
name: 히로히토 천황 사망

src: January — After Hirohito's death from cancer, his posthumous name is Emperor Shōwa. He was the both longest-lived and longest-reigning historical Japanese emperor, as well as the longest-reigning monarch in the world at that time of his death. Crown Prince Akihito succeeded to the Chrysanthemum Throne upon the death of his father becoming the emperor of Japan. This marked the start of the Heisei period.
name: 헤이세이 시대 개막

src: December — During Japanese asset price bubble, Tokyo Stock Market index, Nikkei 225, hits its peak at 38,957 before closing at 38,916 for the day.
name: 니케이 225 최고치 경신

src: January — Japanese asset price bubble has been popped, ending the Japanese economic miracle and triggering the prolonged period of economic decline known as the "Lost Decades".
name: 거품경제 붕괴

src: July — 1993 Okushiri earthquake kills 230 people, but no injuries.
name: 오쿠시리 지진

src: July — In the wake of Japanese economic crisis, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party is defeated in the general elections for the first time since 1955, and the coalition of opposition parties headed by Morihiro Hosokawa takes power.
name: 자민당 총선 패배

src: January — Great Hanshin earthquake: Kansai region earthquake kills 6,434 people and more than 43,792 injured.
name: 한신·아와지 대지진

src: December — The Kyoto Protocol, to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, was adopted.
name: 교토 의정서 채택

src: April — Prime Minister Keizō Obuchi has a mild stroke and resigns. Yoshirō Mori becomes 90th Prime Minister of Japan.
name: 오부치 게이조 사임

src: May — Prime Minister Keizō Obuchi dies of a mild stroke at the hospital in Tokyo at the age of 62.
name: 오부치 게이조 사망

src: April — Prime Minister Yoshirō Mori resigned and Junichiro Koizumi become 91st Prime Minister of Japan.
name: 고이즈미 준이치로 총리 취임

src: July — Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi won the House of Councillors election.
name: 고이즈미 참의원 선거 승리

src: May-30 June — 2002 FIFA World Cup are held in Japan and South Korea.
name: FIFA 월드컵

src: The Firearm Owners Protection Act is signed into law by President Reagan.
name: 총기소유자보호법 제정

src: The Marshall Islands become independent from the United States.
name: 마셜 제도 독립

src: The Fox Broadcasting Company launched, becoming the first "fourth major network" since DuMont to offer nightly programming.
name: 폭스 방송 출범

src: Assorted scandals involve popular televangelists, including Jim Bakker, Oral Roberts, and Jimmy Swaggart.
name: 텔레비전 전도사 스캔들

src: During a visit to Berlin, Germany, President Reagan challenges Soviet General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev to "Tear down this wall!" (referring to the Berlin Wall).
name: 베를린 장벽 연설

src: The Dow Jones Industrial Average falls 22.6% in a single session on Black Monday.
name: 블랙 먼데이

src: November 22, 1987 – An unidentified man wearing the Max Headroom mask appears out of nowhere on television stations WGN-TV and WTTW in Chicago. It is to this day the most notorious television broadcast interruption. As of 2026, the mystery is still unsolved, However, many people on Reddit claim they were behind the crime.
name: 맥스 헤드룸 사건

src: Dennis Conner, on board the challenger boat Stars & Stripes, returns the America's Cup to America.
name: 아메리카스컵 탈환

src: Drunk driving awareness is raised after a drunk driver's car crashes into a church bus near Carrollton, Kentucky, killing 27.
name: 캐롤턴 버스 참사

src: Wrigley Field in Chicago, Illinois, becomes the last Major League Baseball park to add lights for night games.
name: 리글리 필드 조명 설치

src: Discovery is launched as first post-Challenger Space Shuttle flight.
name: 디스커버리호 발사

src: U.S. presidential election, 1988: George H. W. Bush is elected president, Dan Quayle vice president.
name: 부시-퀘일 당선

src: January 20, 1989 – Bush becomes the 41st president, Quayle becomes the 44th vice president.
name: 부시 취임

src: Time Inc. and Warner Communications announce plans for a merger, forming Time Warner.
name: 타임워너 합병

src: Awareness of stalking is raised with the murder of actress Rebecca Schaeffer by an obsessed fan.
name: 레베카 셰퍼 피살

src: Hurricane Hugo strikes the Caribbean and U.S. Southeast Coast, causing $7 billion in damage.
name: 허리케인 휴고

src: President Bush declares a "War on Drugs."
name: 마약과의 전쟁

src: The animated television sitcom The Simpsons debuts on Fox.
name: 심슨 가족 첫 방영

src: President Bush and Soviet Premier Gorbachev release statements indicating that the Cold War between their nations may be coming to an end. Symbolic elsewhere around the world was the fall of the Berlin Wall in Germany.
name: 냉전 종식 선언

src: The World Wide Web first debuts as an Internet service.
name: 월드 와이드 웹 등장

src: The Cold War ends as the USSR is dissolved. The United States becomes the only superpower in the world.
name: 소련 해체

src: Los Angeles riots result in over 60 deaths and $1 billion in damage, spurred by the acquittal of four Los Angeles Police Department officers accused in the videotaped beating of black motorist Rodney King.
name: 로스앤젤레스 폭동

src: Hurricane Andrew, a Category 5 hurricane, kills 65 people and causes $26 billion in damage to Florida and other areas of the U.S. Gulf Coast, and will be the costliest natural disaster until Hurricane Katrina in 2005.
name: 허리케인 앤드루

src: Hurricane Iniki is the strongest hurricane ever to hit Hawaii.
name: 허리케인 이니키

src: U.S. presidential election, 1992: Bill Clinton elected president; Al Gore elected vice president.
name: 클린턴-고어 당선

src: January 20, 1993 — Clinton becomes the 42nd president; Gore becomes the 45th vice president.
name: 클린턴 취임

src: A truck bomb explodes in the parking garage under the World Trade Center in New York City, killing six people and injuring over a thousand.
name: 세계무역센터 폭탄 테러

src: Branch Davidians standoff and fire near Waco, Texas, resulting in the deaths of 81 people including their leader, David Koresh.
name: 웨이코 포위전

src: The "Storm of the Century" strikes the Eastern Seaboard, with blizzard conditions and severe weather, killing 300 people and causing $6 billion in damage.
name: 세기의 폭풍

src: Massive flooding along the Mississippi and Missouri Rivers kill 50 people and devastate the Midwest with $15–$20 billion in damage.
name: 미시시피강 대홍수

src: President Clinton signs 'Don't ask, don't tell' into law which prohibits gay or bisexual people from serving openly in the military.
name: 돈트 애스크 돈트 텔

src: Former Arkansas state employee Paula Jones accuses President Clinton of sexual harassment.
name: 폴라 존스 고발

src: The United States hosts the FIFA World Cup, which is won by Brazil.
name: 미국 월드컵 개최

src: Retired professional football player O. J. Simpson is acquitted of two charges of first-degree murder in the 1994 slayings of his ex-wife, Nicole Brown Simpson, and Ronald Goldman. The nine-month trial receives worldwide publicity.
name: 오제이 심슨 재판

src: A heat wave kills 739 in Chicago, bringing to attention the plight of the urban poor and the elderly in extreme weather conditions.
name: 시카고 폭염

src: 1996 — A budget crisis forces the federal government to shut down for several weeks.
name: 연방정부 셧다운

src: Khobar Towers bombing leaves 19 U.S. servicemen dead in Saudi Arabia.
name: 코바르 타워 폭탄 테러

src: Centennial Olympic Park bombing at Summer Olympics in Atlanta kills 1 and injures 111.
name: 센테니얼 파크 테러

src: U.S. presidential election, 1996: Bill Clinton is re-elected president, Al Gore is re-elected vice president.
name: 클린턴-고어 재선

src: January 20, 1997 — President Clinton and Vice President Gore begin their second terms.
name: 클린턴 2기 출범

src: Sparked by a global economic crisis scare, the Dow Jones Industrial Average follows world markets and plummets 554.26, or 7.18%, to 7,161.15.
name: 다우존스 지수 폭락

src: In the 1998 United States elections, the Republicans hold both the House and the Senate.
name: 공화당 의회 장악

src: 1999 — Clinton–Lewinsky scandal: President Clinton is accused of having a sexual relationship with 22-year-old White House intern Monica Lewinsky. This leads to the impeachment of Clinton later in the year by the U.S. House of Representatives. Clinton is acquitted of all impeachment charges of perjury and obstruction of justice in a 21-day Senate trial.
name: 르윈스키 스캔들

src: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closes above the 10,000 mark for the first time, at 10,006.78.
name: 다우존스 1만선 돌파

src: Teenage students Eric Harris and Dylan Klebold murder 12 other students and one teacher at Columbine High School, sparking an international debate on gun control and bullying.
name: 컬럼바인 고교 총기난사

src: A violent tornado outbreak in Oklahoma kills 50 people, becoming the first one to produce $1 billion in damage.
name: 오클라호마 토네이도

src: Along with the rest of the world, the U.S. prepares for the possible effects of the Y2K bug in computers, which was feared to cause computers to become inoperable and wreak havoc. The problem isn't as large as theorized, preparations are successful, and disaster is averted.
name: Y2K 버그 대비

src: The Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, the USS Cole (DDG-67) is bombed in Yemeni waters, killing seventeen U.S. Navy sailors.
name: USS 콜 폭탄테러

src: U.S. presidential election, 2000: Initial result inconclusive and the result in Florida is disputed. George W. Bush is certified president after a Supreme Court ruling. Al Gore wins the nationwide popular vote but loses the electoral college. Dick Cheney is certified vice president.
name: 미국 대선

src: January 20, 2001 — Bush becomes the 43rd president; Cheney becomes the 46th vice president.
name: 부시 대통령 취임

src: Democrats gain narrow control of Senate after Jim Jeffords defects from the Republican Party.
name: 제퍼즈 탈당

src: Congress passes an emergency bailout package for the airline industry as a result of the attacks
name: 항공업계 구제법안

src: Anthrax attacks kill 5 and infect a further 17 through the U.S. Mail system.
name: 탄저균 우편테러

src: The United States launches the invasion of Afghanistan marking the start of Operation Enduring Freedom.
name: 아프가니스탄 침공

src: The Department of Homeland Security is created in the wake of the September 11 attacks.
name: 국토안보부 창설

src: 10 people are killed and 3 are injured in the Beltway sniper attacks around the Washington D.C. area.
name: 벨트웨이 저격사건

src: Republicans retake narrow control of the Senate following 2002 elections.
name: 공화당 상원 탈환

src: Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrates upon re-entry to the Earth's atmosphere, killing all seven astronauts and resulting in a 29-month suspension of the Space Shuttle program.
name: 컬럼비아호 참사

src: A series of incidents occur that institute a crackdown on building, fire, and safety code violations across the United States, including the E2 nightclub stampede which killed 21, The Station nightclub fire which killed 100, and a porch collapse which killed 13.
U.S. forces continue fighting an insurgency in Iraq while helping the Iraqis build a new army of their own and develop a democratic form of government
In Iraq, deposed Iraqi president Saddam Hussein is captured by U.S. special forces.
name: 사담 후세인 생포

src: The social networking website Facebook is launched.
name: 페이스북 출시

src: The 2004 Atlantic hurricane season produces four deadly and damaging hurricanes which impact Florida, Charley, Frances, Ivan, and Jeanne, which kill a combined 100 people in the U.S. and produce over $50 billion in damage
name: 2004 허리케인 시즌

src: Massachusetts becomes the first state to legalize same-sex marriage in compliance with a ruling from the state's Supreme Court ruling in Goodridge v. Department of Public Health
name: 매사추세츠 동성혼 합법화

src: Former President Ronald Reagan dies from complications resulting from Alzheimer's disease. He lies in state at the U.S. Capitol building before being interred.
name: 로널드 레이건 사망

src: George W. Bush is re-elected president, Dick Cheney is re-elected vice president.
name: 부시 대통령 재선

src: January 20, 2005 — President Bush and Vice President Cheney begin their second terms.
name: 부시 2기 출범

src: The Democratic Party retakes control of both houses of Congress, and gains a majority of state governorships (28-22).
name: 민주당 의회 장악

src: Democrat Nancy Pelosi becomes the first female speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
name: 낸시 펠로시 하원의장

src: George W. Bush orders a troop surge which substantially increases the number of U.S. troops in Iraq and ultimately leads to reductions in casualties and major victories for coalition and Iraqi forces, against the insurgency.
name: 이라크 병력 증파

src: The first iPhone is released for sale in the U.S.
name: 아이폰 출시

src: The I-35W Mississippi River bridge in Minneapolis, Minnesota collapses, killing 13 people. The bridge collapse brings to national attention the need to rehabilitate the aging U.S. infrastructure system.
name: 미네소타 다리 붕괴

src: The Great Recession officially begins in December.
name: 대침체 시작

src: The Super Tuesday tornado outbreak kills over 60 people and produces $1 billion in damage across Arkansas, Kentucky, Tennessee, and Alabama.
name: 슈퍼 화요일 토네이도

src: Steven Kazmierczak kills five, injures 21, and then kills himself in the Northern Illinois University shooting. After this incident, calls are made for more focus on mental health services and interest grows substantially in the group Students for Concealed Carry on Campus.
name: 노던일리노이대 총기난사

src: Hurricane Ike kills 100 people along the Texas coast, produces $31 billion in damage, and contributes to rising oil prices.
name: 허리케인 아이크

src: U.S. oil prices hit a record $147 per barrel in the wake of—among other factors—international tensions and the falling U.S. dollar vs. the Euro.
name: 유가 최고치 기록

src: The 2008 financial crisis begins as the stock market crashes. In response, U.S. President George W. Bush signs the revised Emergency Economic Stabilization Act into law to create a 700 billion dollar Treasury fund to purchase failing bank assets.
name: 2008 금융위기

src: U.S. presidential election, 2008: Barack Obama is elected president, and Joe Biden elected vice president.
name: 미국 대선

src: January 20, 2009 — Obama becomes the 44th president, Biden becomes the 47th vice president. Obama is the first African-American to hold the office.
name: 오바마 대통령 취임

src: The first of a series of Tea Party protests are conducted across the United States, focusing on smaller government, fiscal responsibility, individual freedoms and conservative views of the Constitution.
name: 티파티 시위

src: President Obama obtains Congressional approval for the $787 billion stimulus package, the largest since President Dwight D. Eisenhower.
name: 경기 부양책 승인

src: Pop icon Michael Jackson dies, creating the largest public mourning for an entertainer since the death of Elvis Presley.
name: 마이클 잭슨 사망

src: Nidal Hasan kills 12 servicemen and injures 31 in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.
name: 포트후드 총기 난사

src: The Deepwater Horizon oil rig in the Gulf of Mexico explodes, spilling millions of gallons of oil into the sea. The spill becomes the worst oil spill in American history.
name: 딥워터 허라이즌 유출

src: In the 2010 Midterm elections, the Republicans retake the House of Representatives as the Democrats lose 63 seats.
name: 공화당 하원 탈환

src: Representative Gabrielle Giffords is severely wounded in an assassination attempt when a gunman went on a shooting spree, killing federal judge John Roll and five other people, and wounding at least 13 others, at an event Giffords was hosting in suburban Tucson, Arizona.
name: 투손 총격 사건

src: The ATF gunwalking scandal emerged, wherein thousands of guns were allowed to "walk" through interdiction to Mexico, supposedly to aid in the capture of criminals.
name: ATF 건워킹 스캔들

src: A series of tornadoes cause heavy damage in the South, Alabama being the hardest hit. 324 people are killed in the deadliest American natural disaster since Hurricane Katrina.
name: 남부 토네이도 참사

src: Osama bin Laden, leader of al-Qaeda and mastermind of the September 11 attacks, is killed in Abbottabad, Pakistan, by U.S. Navy SEALs.
name: 오사마 빈라덴 사살

src: A tornado devastates Joplin, Missouri, killing 158 and injuring over 1,000, making it the deadliest single U.S. tornado since the advent of modern weather forecasting
name: 조플린 토네이도

src: Casey Marie Anthony is acquitted of all charges related to the death of her daughter, Caylee; she was convicted of four counts of providing false information to a law enforcement officer. She was released a week later because of credit for time served.
name: 케이시 앤서니 사건

src: STS-135: The Space Shuttle Atlantis touches down at the Shuttle Landing Facility at Kennedy Space Center, ending the 30-year shuttle program, which began with the launch of Space Shuttle Columbia on April 12, 1981.
name: 셔틀 프로그램 종료

src: A gunman kills 12 and injures 70 at a movie theater in Aurora, Colorado.
name: 오로라 영화관 총격

src: Hurricane Sandy strikes the Eastern Seaboard.
name: 허리케인 샌디

src: U.S. presidential election, 2012: Barack Obama reelected president, Joe Biden reelected vice president.
name: 오바마 대통령 재선

src: January 20, 2013 – President Obama and Vice President Biden begin their second terms.
name: 오바마 2기 취임

src: Christopher Dorner murders three people in Southern California, starting the largest manhunt in Los Angeles history. His spree ends in Big Bear Lake, California where he barricades himself in a cabin, kills a second officer, before committing suicide.
name: 도너 총격 사건

src: Edward Snowden leaks highly classified documents from the National Security Agency.
name: 스노든 기밀 유출

src: Terrorists attack the Boston Marathon by detonating two bombs at the finishing line of the race, killing three and injuring 283 runners and spectators. Suspects Tamerlan and Dzhokhar Tsarnaev then led Boston police on a high-speed chase, killing one officer at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Tamerlan was killed in a shootout with police and Dzhokhar was detained the day after.
name: 보스턴 마라톤 테러

src: A tornado devastates suburbs near Oklahoma City, killing 24.
name: 오클라호마 토네이도

src: The most destructive wildfire in Colorado history burns nearly 16,000 acres and kills two people.
name: 콜로라도 산불

src: The Supreme Court strikes down the Defense of Marriage Act, which banned the federal recognition of same-sex marriages and refused to recognize the legal standing of proponents of Proposition 8, which resulted in the re-legalization of same-sex marriage in California.
name: 결혼보호법 위헌 판결

src: Black Lives Matter emerges as a political movement, protesting against widespread racial profiling, police brutality, and racial inequality in the United States criminal justice system.
name: 블랙 라이브스 매터

src: A grand jury decides not to charge Officer Darren Wilson in the shooting death of Michael Brown inciting protests and riots against racism and police brutality in the St. Louis area Causing riot.
name: 퍼거슨 사태

src: The Republicans win the Senate in the Midterm elections.
name: 공화당 상원 장악

src: Dzhokhar Tsarnaev is convicted and sentenced to death for committing the Boston Marathon bombing.
name: 차르나예프 사형 선고

src: Dylann Roof kills 9 people during a Bible study at the Emanuel African Methodist Episcopal Church in Charleston, South Carolina.
name: 찰스턴 교회 총격

src: Rizwan Farook and Tashfeen Malik carried out an attack at the Inland Regional Center in San Bernardino, California, killing 14 and seriously injuring 22 others.
name: 샌버너디노 총격 사건

src: Omar Mateen kills 49 people and injures 53 members of the LGBT community at the Pulse nightclub.
name: 펄스 나이트클럽 총격

src: U.S. presidential election, 2016: Donald Trump elected president, Mike Pence elected vice president.
name: 트럼프 대통령 당선

src: 36 people are killed in the Oakland Warehouse Fire.
name: 오클랜드 창고 화재

src: January 20, 2017 – Trump becomes the 45th president, Pence becomes the 48th vice president. Trump is the first person without prior military or government service to hold the office.
name: 트럼프 대통령 취임

src: Trump fires FBI director James Comey, precipitating the Mueller investigation.
name: 코미 국장 해임

src: Relations between the U.S. and the U.N. and North Korea strain after the country tested missiles in various places.
name: 북한 미사일 시험

src: A white supremacist rally in Charlottesville, Virginia leads to three deaths and to the discussion about racism in modern American society. The term alt-right receives renewed popular consciousness.
name: 샬러츠빌 집회

src: Hurricane Harvey makes landfall in the United States, flooding broad swaths of Texas and Louisiana and causing tens of billions of dollars of damage, making it one of the costliest natural disasters in U.S. history.
name: 허리케인 하비

src: Hurricane Irma makes landfall in Florida and causes tens of billions of dollars of damage. Irma also wrecks the Caribbean Islands.
name: 허리케인 어마

src: Hurricane Maria made landfall on Puerto Rico as a Category 5 hurricane, killing hundreds and knocking out the island's power.
name: 허리케인 마리아

src: October 1, 2017 – A gunman opens fire at a Las Vegas Strip concert, killing 60 people and injuring 867. This was the deadliest mass shooting in modern U.S. history.
name: 라스베이거스 총격 사건

src: November 5, 2017 – A gunman kills 26 people and wounds 22 others at a church in Sutherland Springs, Texas, before killing himself. This was the deadliest mass shooting in Texas history and the deadliest shooting in an American place of worship in modern history.
name: 서덜랜드 스프링스 총격

src: Film producer Harvey Weinstein is accused of sexual harassment in a New York Times expose, marking the beginning of the Me Too movement.
name: 미투 운동

src: February 14, 2018 – A gunman kills 17 people and injures 17 at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida.
name: 파크랜드 총격 사건

src: Donald Trump meets with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in Singapore.
name: 싱가포르 북미정상회담

src: The entire West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals is impeached.
name: 웨스트버지니아 대법원 탄핵

src: October 27, 2018 - A gunman opens fire on the Tree of Life congregation in the Pittsburgh synagogue shooting killing 11 and wounding 6.
name: 피츠버그 유대교회당 총격

src: Creator of SpongeBob SquarePants Stephen Hillenburg and Creative leader of Marvel Comics Stan Lee both die in November.
name: 스티븐 힐런버그 사망

src: November 30, 2018 – Former U.S. President George H. W. Bush dies from complications resulting from Parkinson's disease. He lies in the state at the U.S. Capitol building before being interred.
name: 조지 H.W. 부시 별세

src: All the works published in 1923 except for sound recordings (2022 scheduled events) enter the public domain in the United States.
January 1, 2019 – Washington bans all persons under 21 years of age from purchasing a semi-automatic rifle.
name: 워싱턴주 총기구매 연령제한

src: January 25, 2019 – The second-longest government shutdown in American history, which lasted from December 22, 2018 to January 25, 2019 (35 days), officially ends.
name: 정부 셧다운 종료

src: January 30, 2019 – Large portions of the United States are hit with a polar vortex. The city of Chicago once again hit a record low: 27 degrees below zero. It occurred for fifty-two straight hours.
name: 극지 소용돌이 한파

src: February 1, 2019 – President Donald Trump confirms that the U.S. will leave the Intermediate-range Nuclear Forces Treaty.
name: 중거리핵전력조약 탈퇴

src: Mexican drug boss/lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán is found guilty on all ten counts at a drug-trafficking trial in New York.
name: 엘차포 유죄 판결

src: February 22, 2019 – Singer R. Kelly charged with ten counts of aggravated criminal sexual abuse for incidents dating back as far as the year 1998.
name: R. 켈리 성범죄 기소

src: February 27, 2019 – 2019 North Korea – United States Hanoi Summit held in Vietnam. It is the second summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
name: 북미 하노이 정상회담

src: March 26, 2019 – Vice President Mike Pence orders NASA to fly Americans to the Moon within the next five years, using either government or private carriers.
name: 펜스 부통령 달착륙 지시

src: The Supreme Court case Bucklew V. Precythe rules 5 to 4 that inmates on death row are not guaranteed "painless executions" under the Constitution.
name: 벅클루 대 프리사이스 판결

src: April 4, 2019 – The 1973 War Powers Act Resolution is invoked for the first time when the House of Representatives votes 247–175 to end U.S. military assistance in Saudi Arabia in its intervention in the Yemeni Civil War.
name: 전쟁권한법 결의안 발동

src: April 27, 2019 – A gunman kills one and injures three in a California synagogue. The suspect is white supremacist John Timothy Earnest, who was 19 years old at the time.
name: 캘리포니아 유대교회당 총격

src: May 31, 2019 – A city employee for Virginia Beach enters a municipal building with a gun and kills 12 people.
name: 버지니아비치 시청 총격

src: June 8, 2019 – President Trump reaches an agreement with Mexico to avoid tariffs.
name: 트럼프-멕시코 관세 합의

src: June 9, 2019 – A construction crane falls on an apartment complex in Dallas, killing 1 person and injuring 6.
name: 댈러스 크레인 붕괴 사고

src: June 14, 2019 – One person dies and two more are injured after a gunman entered a Costco in Southern California.
name: 캘리포니아 코스트코 총격

src: July 26, 2019 – The Supreme Court rules in a 5–4 vote to give President Trump $2.5 billion to fund the Mexico–United States border wall.
name: 국경장벽 예산 대법원 판결

src: August 3, 2019 – 23 people are killed and another 23 are injured in a mass shooting at a Walmart in El Paso, Texas.
name: 엘패소 월마트 총격 사건

src: August 4, 2019 – A gunman opens fire on a bar in Dayton, Ohio. He kills nine people and injures another 27.
name: 데이턴 총격 사건
